title: My Google Photos App
content: My Google Photos App. I recommend this app to everyone that asks me about storage for their pics and videos. It saves me tons of space on my iPhone. I really like how you can file pictures under different people and then whatever picture you take with that person in it, it will go under their name and file. It also creates and makes suggestions showing you what your pictures look like on a canvas or in a photo book. They have a lot of options. Last but certainly not least my favorite part by far is the icon you hit when your on a picture with any kind of product you want to buy, it will bring up a list of places that sell that exact product. I use it for my sneaker addiction, when I can’t find a pair of sneakers I specifically am looking for this feature is my best friend. Hope you enjoy it as much as I do!

title: It can’t even view your iOS photo albums…
content: It can’t even view your iOS photo albums…. This app is missing a very basic feature. It does not support viewing the photo albums on your iPhone or iPad. It only shows your main Photo Library (by month) which contains all your photos and videos. This is very frustrating because I’m trying to upload some photos to a friend’s shared album (wedding). I already selected the ones I want to share and added them to my Favorites album. But I can’t even view my Favorites album in this app, or any other albums on my phone. Ironically, it lets you view the albums inside your Google Photos account. Just not the ones on your iOS devices. Conclusion: Unless you want to backup all your photos and videos to Google, or unless you want to sync all your favorites with your Google Photos favorites album, I do not recommend this app at all. I have iCloud backup already. I just want to share some photos with my friends but this app won’t let me do it. I don’t have time to go though the main library to figure out which are the ones I want to share and which ones I do not.

title: Duped into using Google Photo as my primary photo-saving source
content: Duped into using Google Photo as my primary photo-saving source. For several years I resisted the insistence by many to use Google Photos as my primary source to store my digital photos (which I have many), not least of which for fear I’d suddenly need to pay for the storage space or risk inaccessibility to the app and/or lose photos (I’m looking at you . Fast forward a handful of years and that’s exactly what’s happened. I now have to pay Google to increase my storage space to continue uploading photos. It seems extremely unethical to me to promote this (free) app with “unlimited storage” strongly encouraging folx to use it as their one stop shop for all the accumulated and growing digital photos/albums. Not only that, but it’s impacted my email account until I delete photos and videos to create more space. It’s going to take a significant amount of time to transfer all of my photos to another source. I should have trusted my instincts rather than a corporate conglomerate like Google who shamelessly and unapologetically manipulated its customers into buying into their “unlimited” storage service.

title: Please fix these things.
content: Please fix these things.. I love the app because it is easy to work with and has a lot of space to start with. It is not like I cloud where you have to go sign in to delete photos to have more space. You just go into the app and delete the photos you don’t want. I have just had a few issues with photos going where they need to. For example, I tried several time to put 1 screenshot in archive but every time I opened the app again it had not moved. I also keep getting annoying notifications that ask me to buy photo albums and print them. The app should ask if I want to do that once and then be done, not ask me every day. The one year ago and recent highlights folders the app makes on its own are pretty cool because you can see like oh I can’t believe that was a year ago. Overall, the app is pretty good if google photos could fix these things I would rate it a five star.

title: Love it =time saver
content:
Love it =time saver. Great app !!!! It pretty much does all the work for you but of course you make the final decisions. It cleans up your screenshots of papers and or receipts etc. and can put in a folder you made for them. It puts pics into to albums of what you’ve done that day like FB and you can either keep it or not up to you. does your friends phone book recognition and then you can either send the pics to them or not. Stuff you probably already do but now it’s something you don’t have to think about; the app is like a step a head of you and knows what you like while number one SAVES YOU SPACE AND AUTOMATICALLY RETRIEVES PHOTOS FROM PHONE AND DOWNLOAD AND DELETES them ONLY if you want to. The app will ask you if you want to free up space and then pics are
Gone from storage space on iPhone or iCloud can’t remember which one. So all and all it’s a great app and saves lots of space, time and money, money, money, money!!!!!!

title: UPDATE: Extremely Disappointed & Frustrated with Google Photos
content:
UPDATE: Extremely Disappointed & Frustrated with Google Photos. For the past 6+ months I cannot free up space by deleting my phones that are already backed up. I've tried over 100 times at this point and every time it says the delete was cancelled. Now I have no space on my phone. On top of that, I also haven't been able to share photos or open shared albums. I can an error every time. These are the reasons I use Google Photos. Now it's just taking up space. I've seen many other people having the same issues. This is ridiculous. 

Last year...
I take so many pictures and have always struggled with storing them. To me, pictures are memories, so they're important. Google Photos has been a great help. Not only can I store my photos, but they are organized. I can also easily share albums. Google Photos also has really neat features it does on its own. My favorite are the animations. The only thing that would make it better is if the date could make stored with each picture. But at least they are grouped. Overall, Google Photos has been an awesome and helpful addition in storing my photos.

title: Love it
content:
Love it. I started using Google Photos because it was the easiest way to back up an unlimited number of photos to an offsite location. Once I started using it, I discovered that it is filled with little goodies. Sometimes it will notice that you have taken several pictures in the same area and will stitch them together into a panoramic. Sometimes it will notice that you have taken several pictures of the same scene and it will string them into an animation. This is kind of fun when you take several shots of a group trying to pose because you see all the little adjustments people make while you're trying to get the picture right.  I have a few great waterfall animations from this as well.  

If you are taking pictures on your phone as most people do these days, it can group them together by location. In fact, if you take it on a camera that does not know the location a lot of times it can recognize the landmarks and create a folder for pictures taken in Rome, for example.  

I think my favorite feature is that with a little help It can identify pictures of the same person across vast time periods.  Very handy when your friends ask you to help make a slideshow for their daughter's graduation.  

The other major feature that sold me on this product was the ease with which you can share photos. If you have ever tried to share a dozen photos by sending six different emails, you know what a hassle it can be. Now I can just put them in an album and send the link to the album to all the people I want to share with. I can even let them add their own photos to the event if I so wish.

 I have made it a point to recommend a Google photo to my friends and family.

title: Love it!!!
content: Love it!!!. Google Photos is the best! It has helped me so much, especially since I take a lot of photos and videos, it helps me clear out some space, for new photos and videos. It also give my ipad more space for apps. I love how is makes, collages and animations, using similar photos. It also categorizes the different people, that have been seen on you photos, which helps, a lot on finding a specific photo, that you’d like to share with friends and family. Google photos, also customize the photos, I’ve taken, to make them look better, which makes my photos look AMAZING. I love how it backs-up all my things, without having to manually do it. Overall it’s the best app in my opinion, it makes my photography-addiction easier, simpler, and funner. Thank You Google. And anyone who took the time to read this. I hope everyone enjoys this app as much as I do, because to me, IT’S A LIFESAVER. 😍😍☺️☺️🤩🤗💜

title: Held my photos hostage
content: Held my photos hostage. I downloaded this to use the reverse image search and all of the sudden it has uploaded all of my photos from my phone onto its cloud. That used up my 15 gb storage and I could no longer get emails. You’d think this would be an easy fix, but deleting the app and even deleting “Photos” from your Google account do mot fix this. They still keep your photos uploaded. The only way to do delete everything is to physically go through every single photo and delete each one. This took two hours of my life, but I had to do it because I needed my email. Felt like a hostage situation. Make sure you turn off all the syncing between the Google apps and your phone before doing this or else it deletes your photos right off your device as you delete them from the cloud. Insane way of doing things. What’s the point of the cloud— other than backup— if you have to keep all your photos on your phone too? I finally have everything sorted and my photos on my device seem to be safe. This whole ordeal made me so mad I wanted to just get rid of every Google account I have. Big middle finger to Google.

title: Love Google Photos
content: Love Google Photos. It’s simply #1 of all savers of precious moments in life that we capture thru the lens of our camera.! Whether it’s video or photos, Google captures and saves them all in the ever growing cloud basically forever! Now we can reflect on last week or last week ten years ago, all at the simple touch and swipe of your mobile device, laptop, or pc! Hands down the best app on the best web browser the internet has ever known. Google even likes to take your personal moments to create personalized home movies for all to enjoy randomly keeping you amazed with each and every update. If you don’t have Google Photos, you don’t have guaranteed security of your memories in which are priceless. Don’t waste another minute searching for the right app cause it’s right here in front of you because you never know what memory will expire to only be forgotten and lost forever. Kudos to you Google!

title: IF YOU DON’T HAVE THIS APP- GET IT
content: IF YOU DON’T HAVE THIS APP- GET IT. I found this app through my friend because I kept complaining about how annoying it is to sync crap on APPLE products. I needed something simple, something that worked quicker and was more user friendly. THEN my friend told me about this APP and I can’t believe I didn’t have it sooner. I’ve been using it for maybe 5 months now, and it’s the best thing that’s ever happened to me. It automatically syncs with your IPhone photo album and stores are the images for you. NO NEED TO BUY MORE STORAGE because there’s UNLIMITED storage!! After it syncs all your photos from your iPhone photo album, you can easily delete all those photos which continually saves you more room for more photos. Google photo app does it for you!! I also love the PEOPLE feature!! So you can easily find photos for a certain person because it identifies each individual. It’s great stuff!!!

title: Missing one thing I think
content: Missing one thing I think. So I’ve been using Google Photos I don’t know for years and it’s great but the only thing is I think I have like 12,000 photos and or more and there’s no way except for going through manually for duplicate photos because every time they upload they have something different either the name or I edited it, but it’s essentially the same photo so if you could make a similar or duplicate photos setting that I could just hit and it would pull up everything that looks that would be awesome because it changes the name or something and if I do it later, it comes up later if that would be something you can work on that would be great just a suggestion thank you besides that I love having my photos on there so I don’t have to have them on my phone and that they pop up and show me things that happened like 13 years ago. 😀

title: Love, but please increase compatibility on Iphone
content: Love, but please increase compatibility on Iphone. I love Google photos and it is by far the best photo app you can use. However to no fault of Googles own it just does not work well on IPhones in my opinion. Apple incentivizes at every turn that you use their own photo app and has made it difficult to use Google photos fluently within the Apple ecosystem. There should be an option in settings to select your default photos app so people can use 3rd party services like Google photos though every aspect of their iPhone. Currently it feels like a hinderance to use Google photos and I still haven’t figured out a way to even sync or transfer my photos from Google to Apple/vise versa. Please work with Apple to increase compatibility, so people can continue to use the service of their choice, on their platform of choice. As it stands the integration of Google photos onto iPhone is significantly lacking.

title: My Google Photos experience
content: My Google Photos experience. I love that no matter how many times I lose my phone, forget my password or have my identity stolen, I can trust that my photos are in good hands with Google Photos. As long as I use my settings to sync my photos to my account I’m Good. The only problem with that is that I’m always running out of storage and I’m having to upgrade my storage capacity. Then the fear sets in of Google holding my photos hostage until after pay my subscription. Luckily it’s dirt cheap to have lots of storage added to my account. I think I pay like $1.99 for 100gigs of storage. Don’t quote me on that but it’s somewhere in that vicinity. Needless to say after about 23 years of having my Google account I haven’t lost any pictures so I give them 4 stars. If I could merge all my accounts into one photo app then I’d give them 5. Thanks Google for being so dependable without me even noticing it till now.

title: Love the app, storage situation another story
content: Love the app, storage situation another story. This app is fantastic as far as editing and options and pretty much anything you want to do with your photos is an option. It’s excellent. Extremely functional and versatile across the board. Storage is inexpensive and reasonable. The issue I have is I purchased additional storage in the beginning of their downsize up cost plan. And it’s gone after I had to recover my account that additional storage is no longer there. It’s quite frankly a pain. As reasonable and affordable as it is, it’s also currently outside of my means. So my email stopped working back at the first of the year. Gmail was mail main email account with everything including my job services, my unemployment, JFS, the irs, my attorney, my other email accounts, and the list goes on. Hopefully my case is the rare and unusual situation because something that simple has caused me a lot of problems. Just be aware I suppose of what all you’re saving.

title: Unlimited photo storage!!!
content:
Unlimited photo storage!!!. I’m that guy that gets a 256gb iPhone just to manage all my photos. I have a lot going on majority of the time and am taking photos often. No memory goes uncaptured! 

So when I found out google photos allows you to backup your photos fairly seamlessly with the iPhone and have unlimited storage at that..... I figured there was some catch. I was wrong. It’s easy, it’s awesome. It works great. I also share albums with others, for example me and three others took a trip to the Dominican Republic. On the trip down I created an album in google photos and shared that album with them and we all flooded the album with all of our photos from the trip. It works great. Just be sure to note that unlimited storage comes with the one caveat that google is able to compress the photos first. I honestly don’t see a loss in quality, but others might.

title: inconvenient
content: inconvenient. the main reason why i downloaded this app was to make sure that all of my photos are saved, exactly like my camera roll in case of an accident with my phone. the problem is, the app saves all the pictures i have deleted from my camera roll since i downloaded the app. it is very inconvenient, as id like to think that if i had to download these photos onto my phone again that there would not be any unnecessary photos that i would have to waste my time deleting again. it would really help if you made an option in settings to keep deleted photos or not. otherwise, this app works fine and does everything else it says it does. edit: i am now extremely frustrated. when i go into the main photos tab, it doesnt show the photos that i (had to manually) delete, but when i go into the assistant tab, those deleted photos are still in collages and movies! i have a big problem with photos not being deleted for good so this app is basically useless to me. i do NOT like seeing deleted photos when i thought i never had to see them again. this app is absolute garbage.

title: Google Photos Review
content: Google Photos Review. I absolutely Love everything about Google photos!!! The only down fall is the security in place, which is not a bad thing at all just inconvenient when some of us forget our own passwords it is almost impossible and a very lengthy process to recover and be identified as the gmail owner!!! Also I thought the lock out time from your gmail was 6 months of no activity or logins but I was only away for 2 months and when I went to sign back into my account that was still open and active on my device it says I was logged out and needed to sign back in??? Unfortunately I had to get a new number and cannot remember the passwords to my email or the recover email of either since they were each other’s recovery gmails!!! Confusing and frustrating but overall this is the best photo saving, storing, and grouping of cool ideas done by any single photo group!!! I would recommend Google Photos to anyone anywhere!!! Love it!!!

title: Garbage App
content: Garbage App. Absolute trash. Great idea, executed like garbage. The number in the corner apparently refers to the photos not yet backed up, despite all those photos being shown in the app as if they have been backed up. Please make this more clear.  If I scroll through google photos and see 100 of my videos, I assume those videos are backed up and I delete them from my phone, freeing up 7gb and losing every video I took last summer.  User error for sure, but based on wretched, misleading information within this app. It's a great idea and I love it, but I hate it so much.  Please make the numbers more clear or make the un-backed up photos greyed out or have a danger sign on them or something if they're still going to be displayed in the app without being backed up.  As of now, Google Photos is a garbage app made by garbage people who I'm sure are brilliant and kind and well intentioned, but whose work unfortunately happens to be (almost amazing) garbage.  Goodbye Summer of 2017, now I have to rely on my sloppy memories like most of the rest of all people in human history instead of infrequently reviewing my shaky, unfocused, nostalgic videos. Ugh.

title: Love it...for the most part!
content:
Love it...for the most part!. I love that all of my images are backed up and I can access them anywhere. Makes me feel more secure because I love my photos! There are two areas that I have had trouble with which frustrate me. Sometimes it will be uploading images and it says it is done. Then when I go to make an album, it says it still needs to upload images and videos. This can be annoying!  Additionally, I created a shared album where others can contribute. One album my sister tried to add to and I never got the images and she tried more than once. Another time, my dad added images to an album, saw them and then a few weeks later they all disappeared but neither of us had done anything to delete them. One final thing I don't like is when I delete from Google Photos and it deletes from my device. I feel that should be independent.

The photo editor is good but I would like the red eye fix to be added like it was in Picassa.

title: please do not use this unless you want to be unable to use Gmail
content: please do not use this unless you want to be unable to use Gmail. This is the worst app in existence. You will be fine with your normal photos app you do NOT need this. Once you backup all your photos with this when your google “storage” becomes full you are unable to use your Gmail account, and you are unable to receive any emails whatsoever. They only give you 15gb of storage which is very little in my opinion considering the fact that I barely have 4,000 photos. Not only this but once you realize that you are unable to use your Gmail account because your storage is supposedly full they make it quite literally impossible to free up your storage without also deleting the photos you have on your actual device. In addition you have no option to disconnect your google account to your google photos. Therefore you are stuck manually deleting all your photos in order to be able to free up storage and use your Gmail account. This is unbelievable and I advise everyone to save yourself the trouble and just stick your standard photos app.

title: Highly invasive requirements
content: Highly invasive requirements. I use Google Photos for work and family album sharing as a cross platform option for no. iPhone users. The issue I have is that there’s zero options to download photos and videos to google photos, then delete anything extra ONLY from google. You have to go to a computer, delete, and then reject the sync fix options. I’d like to sync to cloud photo and delete without allowing google to manage my iPhone photos. If you’ve ever had a hard drive or platform suddenly lose (or lock up with price hikes) your pictures, you’ll know that this is a bad option. If you use iCloud, it also deletes any photos, but their storage is 1/3 the price. Plus I only want to store my most prized photos and work stuff on Google. At this point I may have to just stop using it and switch back to free, and only have a few family pics. A simple option to delete only from google photos would fix this; but that coupled with those price hikes, I’m looking for better options and will stick with Dropbox for the big backups.

title: Deleted all my stored photos?
content:
Deleted all my stored photos?. I had been using Google Photos for a little over 4 years with no problem, making sure that all my pictures had been properly uploaded and stored in the app before ever deleting them from my phone itself, and it worked great. I had thousands upon thousands of images and videos saved within the app, and plenty of folders created to keep them organized. 
For some reason, some time around April or May, when I opened the app to go search for an old picture, ALL of my images were gone. The only ones remaining were the ones that were also actively on my phone’s camera roll. All my saved images were gone with absolutely no warning or explanation. I tried contacting the Google Photos “help” feature about it, as well as submitting a maintenance report, but I have never heard back. All my memories are gone with no explanation and no ability to recover them. I no longer trust the application and remain devastated that I ever did as it has left me without ability to access a large amount of cherished pictures.

title: Terrible UI changes (video vertical, hiding creations)
content:
Terrible UI changes (video vertical, hiding creations). Normally a great app, Google Photos took 2 steps backwards with the latest release. 
1. Nobody wants vertical/portrait video from Google Photos. It completely ruins the experience. It’s like Google spent years developing a beautiful airplane and then decides to chop its wings off because some competitors are flying helicopters instead. Terrible idea. Has nobody ever tried to watch a portrait mode video on a TV or computer screen? Even on my phone I take and watch videos in landscape because that’s the natural way human eyes work. Our eyes are arranged side by side on our face, not vertically. That’s why we have widescreens for watching videos, not tall screens... and there’s not even an option to choose landscape videos! You’ve given us no choice. Well stop using the feature. 
2. Complicated UI hides favorite features. I used to love scrolling though all of the new auto creations and suggestions in an easy to find location with good control. Now on the app, I can’t even find the creations - and they’re hidden in a clunky carousel with ‘highlight’ photos that I don’t care about - blatant copy of Facebook and instagram stories. I don’t use FB or Instagram partly because I don’t like being forced into a carousel with limited ability to select what I view or navigate the stories (tapping vs swiping, no rewinding videos etc.). I want precision, visibility, and for the user to be in control of the experience. Google has taken that away in an effort to be more like the competition. This completely misses the point. I choose Google because it’s differentiated and a better experience, for varied use cases. Trying to be more like Instagram or FB completely misses the point. 
Please bring back landscape video, and a dedicated creations tab with its own UI (like desktop).

title: Love this app worth the peace of mind
content:
Love this app worth the peace of mind. I was honestly skeptical at first, but this app ended up saving years of my photos and videos that I thought were gone forever. I randomly found pictures from as far back as 2016 that I didn’t even realize had been backed up. That alone made the app worth it for me.

What I really like is how easy it is to use. Once backup is on, it quietly saves everything for you so you don’t have to constantly worry about losing memories if your phone breaks, gets lost, or runs out of storage. It also helps clean up space on your phone without making it confusing.

If you take a lot of photos or videos and you’re on the fence about paying for extra storage, I genuinely think it’s worth it just for the peace of mind. I’d rather pay a little than risk losing years of memories forever.

title: I Love my Google Photo App
content:
I Love my Google Photo App. Google Photo Review
     I am a huge fan of Google photos and my wife gives me a hard time when I try to tell friends and family of its virtues.  I love the storage feature and the ability to sort by face, place or thing, excellent.  I just save all photos on my phone to a computer or some external memory then I can remove from the phone and rely on Google photos to have my pics at the ready.
      I am scanning old pictures into my computer therefore linking those to my Google photos as well.  In the properties, I can also change the date, which allows them to also be searched based on their age and to be found by the Assistant.
      I really enjoy the Assistant feature best.  I can't wait each morning to see what memory appears from the past and some albums are so good, I can share them as is.  Stylized pictures, animations, movies, I love it.  Facial recognition is excellent for finding anyone and I use it constantly.  Sometimes for people's birthdays, I use it to make an album on the person and put it on FB et al.
Love how you can search by almost any item,i.e. Beaches, birds, weddings etc, very useful.
     What would I like, captions for the albums, more editing features on most creations, however, it is terrific as is.  Thanks to the brilliant folks that have created this application!
        Have not much more to ask.  I do have large numbers of Albums and would like an easy way to search for them.  Right now, I have to scroll through them to find what I am looking for.  Still, I use This app more than any other application.  Thanks, don’t stop being creative, continue to improve!

title: Great app, some wishes for messaging
content:
Great app, some wishes for messaging. The app overall has great features like facial recognition and even better TEXT recognition. If I take screenshots of important emails, I can find them again by typing up a word. It can even recognize some non-font writing it it is legible and consistent.

Something I wish was a little improved is the comments on albums. Sometimes they are a bit glitchy, and a notification will show up for a new comment but the comment itself will not appear on the album. 
It would also be nice if comments were available for partner sharing. 
Sometimes I wished there was more connectivity available between google hangouts and google photos - that way photos could be easily sent in a messaging format to others, rather than having to share from the google photos app. I could send photos from google photos via iMessage on my phone but it didn’t have the search options and albums. Having those available in the pull-up menu could also be handy because I make use of those sorting menus to be able to find photos faster and not have to scroll through years of pictures.
These are mostly personal wishes, less so complaints, and stem from unconventional uses of the app.

Overall it is a great app and great software.

title: Easy to access from all my devices
content:
Easy to access from all my devices. One of my favorite Google apps. Keeps all my photos organized and easy to access from all my devices. I have always been a Google fan even though I prefer IOS devices. I like that you are able to back up when only on WiFi or using data. I share my data with others as I’m on a business plan so having this choice really saves on data.
Photography and gardening have become my passion the last few years. With this app, I am able to produce photos that are realistic and if I want to add some flare or erase something, their edit options are endless. 
Never again will you have to scroll and scroll just to find that one picture you took when you were on vacation. Just make an album for your vacation and the app will do the rest. All you have to do is enter in the search engine what picture you are looking for

title: Great app
content:
Great app. I’ve been using Google Photos for about a year now and it’s been really useful. The app lets you save your photos to the cloud, which allows you to see your photos on any device, which is really useful, and the best part is that it’s free (unlike Apple’s photo storage program.)

    Another great aspect of the app is the “Assistant” feature. The assistant is a program that occasionally suggests you to share a photo with your friends (which is really easy in this app), or sometimes it compiles old pictures of documents that you forgot to delete and reminds you of them. One of the best parts of the assistant is when it does “reminders”, in which it puts together an album of old photos from a memorable day or trip. This feature lets you revisit an almost forgotten day, and it can be quite nostalgic.

    Overall, I would really recommend downloading the app

title: L♡VE G PHOTOS - needs some improvements
content:
L♡VE G PHOTOS - needs some improvements. ➊ Can you please make google photos available as a widget on the iPhone 
⮑(Like when you select photos on Apple’s camera roll app and click share, can you make it so there’s a button for importing to google photos - I’m not sure what it’s called but I know that apps like VSCO have this option.)

➋ Can you offer a way to sort images on Google photos? 
⮑ sometimes the app gets the date wrong so my photos are all out of order and it’s difficult to find what I’m looking for. (It would be nice if I could sort it by most recent or recently added) 

➌ Importing needs improvements. 
⮑ I use google photos to backup my pictures and right now, in order to import pictures directly to an album, I have to airdrop the pictures I want from my iPhone to my Mac then click and drag the pictures into the album I want on google photos. It’s very inconvenient but it works. However, my WiFi is under repair right now so airdrop is not an option and I want to add photos to my google photos album EXCEPT it’s too difficult to find them on google photos because they all have different dates! 

➍ Doubles! 
⮑ please offer a feature that identifies doubles of pictures and gives u the option to remove one of the copies! (Maybe in google assistant) This would be great - although, not necessary, but much appreciated if possible in the near future!

title: Love love love it!
content:
Love love love it!. Google photos gives me great peace of mind that my photos and videos are always there for me and accessible. Gone are the days of worrying about lost or damaged flash drives and CD’s full of photos!
 
I have the Google Photos app on my phone (which is also my camera), so it’s super easy to upload all of them anytime — and bonus! it’s also super easy to clear up space on my phone (I can direct the app to delete photos from the phone that have been saved in the cloud). 

Google Photos makes it easy to share photos if I want to (I’m a private person, so I don’t share very widely). 

I love the versatility of the search feature, especially when I’m putting together an album or a collage, because I can search, say, “Emma December,” and it pulls forward all the images that contain Emma that we’re taken in December (after I have assigned a name to her face— also my choice). And if I have the location feature turned on when I take my photos, then I can search within Google Photos by location. 

Today I’m really excited because it seems like Google Photos has updated the app, so now I can see and select individual photos that were taken within a “burst” on my iPhone.

The unlimited storage is AMAZING. I take LOTS of pictures, and I know I can keep them ALL in ONE PLACE! It’s absolutely fantastic!

title: Overrated n disappointing and false AI abilities
content: Overrated n disappointing and false AI abilities. This app was my fav a few yrs ago but had quickly become the worst experience I had. If it’s MY pics let ME sort n categorize them not you (app) it’s absolutely without a doubt, horrible! Ever since you claimed it knows me n can AI it all for me - is totally false. So how does a food entree pic qualify as a mountain when nothing like that no where near or part of the pic n location was in big city … so much for “smart organizing” the list I could give goes on n on n I can hardly ever find what I want r need. Plus it used to allow me to make my own files n put them there (move) from my main pic gallery (if I chose that option) to another pic file. Now I can NOT do anything that I want with any of MY pics/ notice they r MY pics not yours!! Truly saddened n disappointed you made it all worse instead of better … why fix something that was not ever broken? Worked for me and so many others … wish could have the previous version blended with the “dumb” (not so smart) version - then that would be a great accomplishment!

title: Don’t skip over this bc it’s here for everybody to read
content: Don’t skip over this bc it’s here for everybody to read. I like the his app bc it give you so much storage. I’ve never found a app like this bc I always get notifications saying “your storage is full please delete some pictures “ but I never get a notification on google photos. I have way too much storage... probably more than I need. You also get an assistant were they make suggestions and stuff. I like this part bc whenever I am having trouble editing a photo, it dose it for me. There are also hidden features that I have also discovered myself. It also makes suggestions like “ you have 333 pictures, would you like to delete some?” And it allows you to go through the list and check off some pics that you would like to keep and then it deletes the rest. I have gotten so organized with google photos. I highly recommend this to ANYONE

title: My absolute favorite app!!!
content: My absolute favorite app!!!. I can’t express enough how much I love this app. I am a photo hoarder, between pictures of my children, family and friends, events I want to attend, crafts I want to create; with this app I never lose any of it. Before getting this app I was constantly backing my phone to my computer then to an external hard-dive (such a pain). I never have to do that anymore and I can access my pictures WHENEVER I want. If that wasn’t enough, you can identify each person and use the search to narrow down a picture you might be looking for (either a person, location, even a color or pet). Even more, the app will randomly generate movies (for something special like Mother’s Day or after an event like Christmas) including background music, collages, animations, color pops, and more. There is no app I boast about more. I would recommends Google Photos to EVERYONE!!!

title: Google photos is a lifesaver!!
content: Google photos is a lifesaver!!. As a professional photographer, this app is truly a dream come true. Free, unlimited storage for all of my photos and videos, and there’s no catch! I love having the ability to organize my work by creating albums within the app. Google Photos also offers awesome creations of my work to include stylized photos, collages, animations, a “rediscover this day” feature that brings back so many beautiful memories, movies, panoramic versions of my work and so much more. Google Photos also has an easy to use built in photo editor that allows me to enhance my work without changing to countless other apps. I am beyond grateful for this app and the generosity of its creators in allowing me free storage that really is free. I will continue to use Google Photos for as long as it is available to me, and I hope that’s forever because I truly cannot imagine my life without it.

title: Don't know what you have until you don't have it anymore
content:
Don't know what you have until you don't have it anymore. Recently, our external hard drive crashed and we were devastated because every single one of our children's baby pictures were on it. So we sent it off to a data retrieval service, and was informed that none of the images were retrievable. We were heartbroken and very sad, until I remembered Google Picasa! So I opened the app and was ecstatic to find many of my children's baby pictures. Of course not everything was uploaded to Picasa because my husband did not download the app to his phone until after our external hard drive crashed. But we are very happy to have what we have.

So all I can say is, you don't realize how valuable Picasa is until you need it.

I have to admit, I have not used Picasa since I bought my iPhone. However, with the recent events I will be using it daily. So, thanks Google!

title: Love the extra features
content: Love the extra features. This app is probably my favorite and most important on my phone. It continually backups photos I take so I never have to worry about losing photos if I haven’t backed my iPhone to iTunes in a while. It also provides search capabilities with grouping by person, activity, place and even things. I take a lot of screenshots of things and it has the ability to archive them so they do not clutter the main section. Probably what I like most though is the extra little things it makes like collages, movies, stylized photos and animations. While some of them are do not come out good, there are times where they give me something I didn’t even know I wanted. Most recently they provided me with a before and after collage and I just loved it. Would definitely recommend this app for anyone that cherish their photos and the memories behind them.

title: Mind Reading Photo App
content: Mind Reading Photo App. My phone is an iPhone; my laptop is a MacBook Pro; my desktop is an iMac; and, I use my Apple Airbuds, iPad and TV almost daily. As a professional, mother of three, with no formal training in technology, I value the seamlessness and reliability of my Apple technology; I never think twice about whether or where my projects, emails, documents, etc. are on any of my devices... EXCEPT, MY PHOTOS ARE NEVER WHERE I THOUGHT THEY WERE! Of course, that’s my fault - I’m not blaming Apple. But, I’m officially DONE watching instructional videos, wading through advice from other Mac users, etc. GOOGLE HAS READ MY MIND! My photos are reliably available for viewing, incorporating, sharing, creating, etc. anytime on any device. The organization provided is intuitive and the options offered responsive - without limits! No more endless searches, no more frustration, no more anxiety - ONLY GOOGLE PHOTOS! Thank you, Google!

title: Horrible app
content:
Horrible app. Google may be amazing in some other areas but they definitely did a horrible job on Photos. I’m glad I didn’t buy any storage. It’s complicated to navigate, Lost a bunch of pictures and videos in the learning process, very frustrating app. 
Pics and videos take forever to upload to the cloud.  it’s been three days and still uploading two videos one for 15 minutes and the other one for 11 minutes. You can’t move the albums to organize them in alphabetical order. If I want to delete a pic from ur phone You have to be very careful when deleting videos and photographs is a mess. Also installed the app on a second iPhone and tried to upload some other stuff from that other phone to the same account, well guess what, is the same google account and the pics and videos on one are not the same as the other. Also when I deleted some videos from one of the phones it also deleted from the other cloud and that’s how I lost a bunch of videos. 
Anyway. I invite you to research a bit more before using. Thank you google for erasing some of my treasured memories!

title: Still amazing
content:
Still amazing. Started using Google photos years ago. Back when I first really understood how the cloud works on my iPhone. Finding out that once my storage on my phone was close to full, deleting photos from my phone that were backed up on the cloud would also delete them from my cloud and I’d lose the photo forever. Dumbest concept ever. I started researching an alternative and found this brilliant app from Google and it has been my lifesaver for years now. I’m serious. My photos are everything to me. I’m a self proclaimed artist. Be it writing, sketching, painting, or digitally- I love expressing myself without needing to use my actual voice. And photography as well as graphic designing make up some of my favorite forms of expression. If I lost any of my photos I’d be honestly crushed. To be able to go back through all my different phones, all the years gone by, right in Google photos albums, having everything there, that photo I took 5 years ago from the quiet walk bridge right before sunrise after an emotional hike with only myself and my phone, to have that photo sitting safely in my Google album, knowing it’s there, pulling it up when I need to remember, that’s everything to me. 
Nothings changed either. They now have a cap on the free part. Understandably. I gotta imagine that it’s beyond time they asked for some type of payment. The way they did it was pretty honorable and impressive. They don’t threaten to trash everything we’ve already saved, no matter it’s capacity (I truly have thousands upon thousands upon thousands of photos), they allow us to keep that, and they allow us an impressive cap before needing to request that we pay to continue to have everything backed up. 15 GB’s is damned impressive. For free??? You can’t beat that. It’s a universal, unlocked back up bank with 15 gb of space for free. You just can’t beat it. I’m changing phones again. New iPhone. And that’s why I’m leaving another review. Because I’m making sure everything is backed up and while I’m waiting for it to all be backed up I decided to give another rating and review. Because I love this app. It’s worth it. It’s awesome. It’s free. It’s honest.

title: Amazing Features that make up for what Apple Photos lacks
content:
Amazing Features that make up for what Apple Photos lacks. I have been blown away by the extremely useful features Google Photos includes! I’ve been frustrated in the past with my photo library’s organization (or lack there of), photos of receipts for expense reports that I should’ve/needed to get rid of, duplicate photos, etc. Google Photos has features that help you maintain and organize your library!!

One of the coolest features of all, though, is the ability to search for photos by using a word. For example, I can search for the term “whiteboard” and Google Photos will show me all my photos that are of a whiteboard! It’s an intelligent feature that can go further than that, for example, searching for “diagram” or “architecture” will show me the subset of whiteboard photos that match those topics/categories!

title: Great App Except .....
content: Great App Except ...... I love their "Assistant", which configures videos, stylized photos, albums, etc.  It's wonderful!  You can download their creations, print them through third party labs, save the videos to discs, etc. The only thing that you cannot do, which I find truly disappointing, is send their albums to be printed as actual albums to include all the wonderful embellishments that they formatted. They do such a wonderful job with their embellishments, which include maps and arrows of times that you travelled. I soooo wish that all of that would be printable in a photo album as well. I would be willing to pay a nominal fee for this service. They do such a beautiful job, and would save you a considerable amount of time of having to add these embellishments yourself....many of which are not even available at photo labs because they're so customized. It is truly frustrating!!!!!

title: Thanks Google!
content: Thanks Google!. I love this app! After I took the time to become familiar with all of its features, I realized how great it actually is. Rather than going to get family pictures/videos done at some place that charges ridiculous prices for so few pictures, I can just take pictures/videos with my phone, edit them, order, and have them sent right from google at a very reasonable price. This app has saved all of the photos from every phone we’ve had in the past few years or so. Considering myself, 5 kids, and my wife... That’s a lot of different phones!!! I found pictures and videos that I thought I’d lost forever and there they were. Just sitting there waiting for me. Thanks google for such a great app. Myself and my family will continue to use and recommend google photos for as long as possible. 10 stars in my book!!!

title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS APP!!
content:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS APP!!. So when you download this app and allow it to sync, it immediately starts doing that with all of your iPhone photos. Next, you’ll get an alert from Google that you are out of storage. So you think, easy- I’ll just delete all the pics from Google photos, I didn’t really want to use it anyways. Well you can’t do that. Not only does the delete button do NOTHING on an individual photo or group of photo, it seems that even in the best of times they don’t provide a way to bulk delete photos using your phone. You have to click on each individual photo. Then you go to the web app and it turns out there’s no bulk option there either AND the delete button doesn’t work. So in a panic because you can no longer get emails on your main email account, you have to pay to upgrade your Google storage. 

There’s also no way to directly contact Google about this. If you search Reddit this has been an issue for weeks. I’m so disgusted and frustrated. Do not, under any circumstance, download this app!

title: Photos are gone
content: Photos are gone. I have over 12 years of photos gone. Just gone. I have had this app for almost a year now and I haven’t hardly had any issues with it. Except for this one thing that has happened like three times. I’ll go onto the app to look at old photos per usual and I decided I wanted to do this again a few days ago and photos from 12+ years are gone probably over 10,000 photos are gone. I have tried emailing and reaching out to the company multiple times and they still have not responded. I found out this has happened to other people as well and as far as I’m concerned, there’s no way to fix it. Yes, these photos had been saved in the app so there should be no reason that they just disappear like this. My mom has this app and she probably has around 20,000 or more photos on it right now and nothing has gone wrong for her. I’m just really hoping that Google photos can finally look at my emails and complain and fix this issue if possible.

title: Not bad, but could be better……
content:
Not bad, but could be better……. Their AI protocols try to second guess one's intentions. For example, I sometimes take more than one photo and then the Google AI protocols will flag them and then a badge will appear at later time, because "it thinks" they're duplicates. I'll get a message, "Look what we found, two of the same or something like this"…… 

Hey I guess the geeks who mulled over this app design probably thought that it was just pure genius, well, I think it's just annoying!! And I'm not from your average Joe family either. I come from a scientific background and upbringing!! My dad is a retired research physicist and my mum's quite intelligent as well!!! Some people may have never heard of Argonne National Laboratory near Lemont, IL USA, but that's where my dad worked for 35 long years until he left in 2000. His area of specialty was superconductivity. I used to accompany him when he would go to the laboratory to check on his experiments. I'd ask all sorts of questions about what he was doing IN DETAIL!!! Anyhoo, 'nuff said!!

title: Was working great until iOS 15.1
content: Was working great until iOS 15.1. I only put a low rating because this issue is really urgent. title: My “Go to” photo album/gallery
content: My “Go to” photo album/gallery. I’ve always been a fan of photography/taking photos. I am a freelance photographer and also sell items online. I do take so many different types of photos like: pics of clients, pics of items I sell online, my precious dog & daily pics, too. Therefore, I do not delete many photos bc I may need to re-use it again in the future. Google Photos is my #1 back up source and almost daily “go to” app for my photo needs. Only bc it is SO EASILY ACCESSIBLE from ALL my different devices. As of today I have 41,223 pics on this app. I decided to upgrade & get a Google One account for another back up but this does ENTIRE cell backup it’s only $1.99/month for 1tb & allows you special access to other “hidden treasures” from Google. I’m a VERY BIG fan of ANY & ALL Google items. They have not let me down.

title: It’s great but I have a recommendation
content:
It’s great but I have a recommendation. I love Google Photos! It allows me to not only have more space on my phone, but it sends me a stylized photo to give it more feeling. I love it way more than the regular  photos app because it also can fix the lighting on a photo so you can see it way clearer. Also, the lighting can put a filter on it so it kinda “sets the mood”. It is fun because you can create collages, animations, and even a mini movie!
   The movies are fun, but there is a flaw. Recently, one of my pets died so I wanted to make an “In Loving Memory” movie in honor of her. When I went to add stuff, it said it had to be from the “people” album! No pictures of my lizard were shown, so I couldn’t make my movie of her. Even for the movie of a dog or cat, it only shows people as an option!
This should be fixed so all movies with a title could be made of a pet, or anything else it is centered around, not just people. Thanks for reading!

title: Deletes photos from your device.
content:
Deletes photos from your device.. Update to review:
I got a response from the developer with links about my issues and how to resolve it, and typical of developers they did not read my review. They skimmed it to look for key words or used an AI to "read" it. The link they gave me was what I suggested in my review to new users.  I had already read through their help section and it is the same as the link. 


Original Review:
Make sure you disable sync if you want to delete photos from the Google drive but not from your device, otherwise it will also be deleted from your device. And you only have 30 days, if you haven't permantly deleted from Google drive, to recover it. There were several important videos I thought were saved on an older phone so it wouldn't take up space on my new phone and didn't think I needed it on Google drive. Not the case, if that old phone has your Google account logged on and it's set to sync and you delete from the Google drive, the photo or video is deleted. I would think if you delete from Google drive it's only from that drive and not from any and all connected devices. Also assumed it only synced if you add or delete from your device, and not from their drive.  Now I have to find a third party app to try to recover those videos. No thanks to Google.

So if you want to delete from their drive but not from your device, make absolutely sure "sync" is turned off.

title: Was great now new update makes it extremely frustrating to use.
content:
Was great now new update makes it extremely frustrating to use.. The new update for adding photos into albums is horrendous. Previously they would be sorted by either most recent picture added by date or by last updated. Now they are sorted by... I have no idea. I'm trying to add a photo into an album that was last updated a week ago but the first option that pops up now is from 7 years ago. title: GOOGLE PHOTOS = BEST APP EVER!!!!
content:
GOOGLE PHOTOS = BEST APP EVER!!!!. I’ve been using Google photos for about 6 years, and I have LOVED every minute of it! It’s really easy to use, and the absolute best option out there for storing photos. There are so many cool, helpful features to help keep my photos organized. And if you’re looking for a specific photo or video, you can just search for key words and it will usually come up. You can search “flowers”, “Chicago”, birthday”, “mug”, “wheelchair”, etc. You can type in a date or location and search that way, too. 

This app also recognizes faces, and you can label them, click on a person or pet’s face and name and see all the photos you have of that person. You can search “Dad”, “Grandma”, “Max” etc and they will come up that way too.

You can add photos/videos to albums, make collages, edit them, view “on this day” memories, hide photos of a specific person or pet, and hide photos of specific dates or locations, so that you only you see the memories you WANT to see. I am still learning about some of the awesome features and how to use them!

There are so many things you can do on this app WITHOUT needing tons of storage space! If my phone storage gets full, all I have to do is go to Google photos and click “free up space”. It deletes everything that has already backed up to the app (can be done over just wifi or data, you choose in settings), you don’t even have to sort through them at all. It usually doesn’t take very long to back everything up either. I have always taken ridiculous amounts of pictures and videos, and I save plenty from the internet too. And after 6 years of doing this, I have still not ran out of FREE storage!

Well done, Google. Hands down my favorite app out there! Keep up the good work :)

I wish it would let you group individual people and was more like Picassa! Dates and places are ALL MESSED UP! Google can do much better! You should have combined it with Piccasa!

title: They make sharing personal photos 98% MUST
content:
They make sharing personal photos 98% MUST. Aside from jumping endless hurdles regarding attempts from every angle to make one share personal photos, endlessly attempting to infiltrate your contacts & perhaps become the next Facebook the programming is otherwise amazing.  However I just don't trust all of the strategizing to infiltrate & keep my personal photos, contacts & all of the private info stored with my contacts.  I'm always afraid I'll unknowingly start sending personal photos with- perhaps a business client.  I love the storage, I love the photo tools, video is good as well & I do want to share some of my photos with commentary but I feel as if I'm required to set up a permanent line of future data sharing with people I don't necessarily want to constantly send photos to.  I also want to be able to move some of my photos to different apps but I feel as if I'm locked in with Google without an out for my photos if I need one.  Plain & simple I don't appreciate the fact that I & my personal data are locked up tight with Google.  If I could move my info, if I could allow access to my personal information without fear of having it turned into a three ring circus for others to copy, send, share, comment about etc., I would likely be much more apt to open up & actually share but every move I make requires a new friend group to permanently share with.  The program does allow outs but you must learn it and familiarize yourself with the program for months to get a decent working knowledge of the endless loopholes & small print.  It literally scares me & on top of that Google has started a hard left liberal edge with its news coverage & endless attempts to push political left rhetoric.  I want fair & unbiased news as well as content such as public photos.  

It's hard to trust Google with my own photos & info when I constantly watch them publishing completely biased information day after day.  

I want to love Google but I'm scared to do so.  I'll stick with them though and hope they change their " manage the sheeple" attitudes and rhetoric.

title: Ate 4 gigs of data backing up a 2 minute video
content: Ate 4 gigs of data backing up a 2 minute video. I'd love it if this app wasn't trying to be good at everything and just focus on being a good media storage source. While I love that I can store 3 years of photos and videos easily on my phone, this app is a serious data hog. Before using this app, make sure you have checked all settings regarding the apps data usage. Make sure you have turned off Its ability to use background data and check the "only backup videos on wifi" box. I was trying to clean up my phone quickly before an event Saturday and thought I would switch the "wifi only" mode off for a few minutes to get some of my videos backed up faster. (Because it literally takes this app DAYS to do it over wifi). In less than 5 minutes I got a text from Verizon saying I was almost out of data. The app hadn't backed up more than two minutes worth of video, but ate 4 gigs of data doing it. In less than 5 minutes. Now I am looking for other options to backup my media and delete this app all together.

title: so good for low storage
content: so good for low storage. My phone only has 64 gb, so this is amazing for clearing up storage! I have google one, which gives me 100 gb of storage for about $2 a month! super easy to use, and comes with lots of benefits that my iPhone camera roll doesn’t have (rotates photos, easier to work, has tools like background erasers, etc)! my only complaint is there are some images / videos from my iPhone's camera roll that do not save / show up in google photos, so they still take up storage in my camera roll. There is also no easy way that I’ve found to upload pictures that are not in my camera roll. Along with this, i haven’t found a way to save pictures / videos sent in messages straight to google photos without saving to camera roll first. Regardless, though, this app is great, and worth your money if you decide to upgrade to google one!!

title: tried to delete my photos from my phone
content:
tried to delete my photos from my phone. TLDR: I wanted to turn off syncing videos because they were using up all of my storage and ended up cancelling the backup service all together. 

I liked using Google Photos to have low res backups of my photos that were linked to my TimeHop. I did this because several years ago google photos was like “hey! store all of your photos here in low-res with no storage limits!” and then they did the bait and switch and removed that to try to get me to buy a plan. So my notifications have been going off like crazy that my Google storage is at 80%. All I wanted to do was stop my videos from syncing, which somehow isn’t an option (because they WANT you to use up your storage and buy a plan!). Instead Google Photos tried to delete 5,000 photos from my phone because it decided that it’s low-res copies were all it needed. Wow, what a pushy app. I’ve fully turned off syncing. You’re Google…how do you NOT have more customizability with your backup?? But also this whole process has been sooo shady.

title: Google photos
