title: Getting buggy
content: Getting buggy. Ive used google photos for the past 10 years or so. Ive noticed it getting buggy especially in the AI features. About half the time I load in a photo to use magic eraser. There’s a bizarre glitch that permanently makes the photo look like it’s been stamped with itself over and over again, like a double exposure. It is also odd to me that once you use magic research to remove someone in the background, you can no longer edit any other aspect about the photo such as exposure or color. I have also noticed on iPhone a weird phenomenon where once you hit save on an edited photo the end result actually looks different than when it was being edited. Like the preview of the photo during editing is not accurate. All of these things combined has made me really loose trust for this app and no longer want to edit photos with it.

title: Amazing app
content:
Amazing app. Loving google photos!!! Have been recommending all friends and family download. Has been such a great of having all photos backed up and saved and shared between friends. Love that it backs up all my photos so they’re always available. Sometimes have issues with creating an album and then not being able to share it because the app is still uploading.. have discovered the workaround of simply creating a shared album from the get go. 

Loving the addition of creating photo books. Would like to have more flexibility to edit the book and add captions.

Only main issue is that sometimes when sharing albums, it doesn’t always sync with others and they’re not always able to access. Have this issue quite often and usually when photos have just been uploaded.. would love if this can be fixed.

title: Could be better
content: Could be better. Google photos is a good app, but not the best. Photo quality goes down the more you move and send photos. I have an Apple phone, and I have discovered that whenever I delete photos from google photos they delete from my phone too. That’s really annoying, because I don’t think I turned on that setting, and I can’t even figure out what setting it is. I don’t appreciate them deleting photos from MY phone. I’m an amateur photographer so it is nice to send photos to other people, but again the quality goes down every time I share them with others. Also when adding photos to individual albums, all of the photos rearrange themselves in different order which makes editing them a pain.  And when I edit/delete them from my phone they stay on google photos so I have to go on google photos and delete and edit them AGAIN. And deleting can be a pain too sometimes.

title: So much better than I would have thought!
content: So much better than I would have thought!. Honestly Google Photos is amazing. I’ve never rated an app before but this deserves it. I find pictures so much easier and quicker than ever now! You can search for whatever you want a picture of— specific people in photos with you, places pictures were taken, and any other feature. I'm also able to save a ridiculous amount of storage just by using this app, and it’s so much better than the regular apple camera roll! 10/10 recommend. Google Photos even gives you suggestions on how you can edit pictures with filters, rotating them, and more! You will never stress about being unable to find a picture or your phone storage ever again, I can promise you that.

title: Great solution for photo storage
content:
Great solution for photo storage. I’ve been using this app for about two years or more now and it’s been a pretty great help. I had a baby girl about two years ago and am taking CONSTANT photos of her and can’t bring myself to delete even the bad ones. Google Photos has really helped me feel fulfilled in my baby picture quota! Today they even made a really sweet video of sections of other videos of my daughter spliced together to show her growth over the past two years and, while I should feel violated because there probably was a real person going over intimate moments and that whole invasion of privacy, I can’t really bring myself to care. 
**Note: I have absolutely no evidence it wasn’t just computer generated. It was just so perfect I have a hard time believe it wasn’t a human hand’s work.

title: Super great app!
content:
Super great app!. I love Google Photos because your entire phone photo library is backed up into the cloud storage for free and without taking up any space. The app even gives you tons of information about the picture that the iPhone photos app does not (ex. coordinates of location, device taken on, exposure, file name). You can edit the pictures and even combine them into a video slideshow with a variety of available filters. I especially love that it can easily recognize people's faces in pictures and group them all together once you label a name or contact from your phone of who it is! I really recommend this app!

If I were to suggest a change, I would love to be able to AirDrop pictures/videos to those around me straight from the app rather than having to save the file first.

title: Pretty darn cool
content: Pretty darn cool. It is very awesome to have a photo app that will save my photos so that I don’t have to use up memory space.  That being said, I know there are other photo apps.  I was introduced to this one because two of my daughters use it, and if I want to see pics of my grandkids I can see them easily with this app since it’s what they use.  Also I do like Google for the most part.   My other daughter uses a different photo app.  I prefer this one, just because I’m more familiar with it.  Still it is not as easy as I think it could be to navigate the different things you can do.  I also would like the ability to share pics via text message and not just email or other Google photo accounts.  To be fair, I haven’t sat down and taken the time to learn the app.  Once I do, I might just give it a different rating.  I do still think it’s pretty cool!

title: Great app
content: Great app. Such a great storage option! I ALWAYS had issue with storage and saving my photos but now that I have this app, I don’t have to worry about losing my photos ever again! I love that I don’t have to pay 100 dollars a year for a storage limit. This app is a life saver. I don’t have to worry about uploading my photos myself because as soon as I take them, google photos solves that for me. I also love the cute little animations that the app creates. The only reason I gave it four stars is because there’s a glitch or issue with trying to search for old photos! Every time I search a year or a month up to look for photos, I’m only allowed to scroll past a certain point. When I try to scroll and load older photos, the app takes me right back up to the top! I wish for this issue to be fixed because I can’t search for old photos anymore!

title: Lacking major features
content:
Lacking major features. There may be several issues I’m having where I’ve made some error or overlooked a “workaround / life hack” to accomplishing my needs, but so far, here are a few of my frustrations:

Doesn’t identify and help clear duplicates based off metadata and/or image content.

Doesn’t auto suggest best pic of group.

Makes movies and collages based off date and time and location, not content.

Suggests random crops to images that make no sense.

Can’t create a photo database with filters and tag words the way I need.

Keeps suggesting I share private images with family. NO! Why would I?

Let’s me download some images and videos, but not others.

Takes a long time to download from the cloud... which cloud? Who knows!

Won’t necessarily upload in background.

Can’t give 1-5 hierarchy rating to the quality. 

Assistant doesn’t provide consistent offers.

Won’t clear the 40,000 images from my iPhone and iCloud as instructed.

Constantly given “cannot backup 800 photos” cues, but no real explanation as to why / why not.

Creates duplicates in my google drive. 

Little control over parameters.

Doesn’t read text in photos.

Search feature overlooks certain words and phrasing must be identical when searching.

Pretty amazing photo ID at times, horrible at other times.

Doesn’t feel like advanced AI.

Can’t remove photos from iPhone and leave them on icloud.

Can’t plug-in to certain apps.

title: Google is so smart!
content: Google is so smart!. I just uploaded all 100,000 of my photos over last 20 years to Google Photos at high resolution (up to 16MP), which has unlimited quota.  Now I can browse and search by people, location, object, and even activity, in a snap!  This is light years ahead of the search capability of iCloud or other online photo albums. Google will auto detect and group faces, auto update the photo albums as you take more photos on iPhone and sync to google photos.  I am looking forward to more smartness from Google.  Nice work, Google Photos team!

title: I love Google Photo’s
content:

title: Amazing App
content: Amazing App. After repeated attempts to delete, technical support, hair pulling and nail biting weeks trying to access my ICLOUD I finally gave up and called my carrier to have them just go in and delete all my pictures in my iCloud because I have already deleted all from my phone but I still keep getting that dreaded message that says "my iCloud is full" I was fed up just delete it. I'm so thrilled I have this and will never think or anything other than google after this experience!!! Way to go Google!!!

title: Thoughtful
content:
Thoughtful. This app really tries to connect thoughtful memories of you and your family. Sure, its not perfect. But for an automotive story, it can create real emotional moments and produce moments you haven’t thought of. 
A lot of us sum up our lives with emojis or gifs. Google photos seeks to find a way to bridge the gap and provide us with a FREE way to transgress the boundaries of social media and capture the emotion of every moment we experience.
I adore the fact that Google reminds me of birthdays and anniversaries no matter the importance. And they celebrate the moment with a quick story that you can adjust depending on your comfort or status. 
I’ve never been disappointed with Google products and this I just another step in the evolution of an amazing service.
Thank you Google, for helping me remember the memorable moments

title: Great app
content:
Great app. Okay so the fact that is stores your photos is awesome. For those of you that don't know it does compress them as a smaller size but if you do research into it the compressing really doesn't reduce the image quality that much. There are plenty of side by side comparisons and you can hardly tell the difference. That is awesome by itself next awesome part is it combines photos or videos you have taken making pretty cool collages and animations which are almost like iPhone Live Photos which is amazing this app is fantastic! You need to use it! 
Update: my previous statement was an underestimation it has continuously shown me pictures of events from this day a year or two ago and they are spectacular because it brings back awesome memories and the videos it makes are fantastic. This is a fantastic app!!

title: Some things you should know
content: Some things you should know. First of all, this is a great app. But I wouldn’t go crazy over it. For one thing, if you have a slow internet service, it will take forreevveer to upload photos. I’ve had this app for over two weeks and so far I’ve had to manually select longer videos to get them to upload, and after that it takes about five hours plus to upload eight videos. That’s just my WiFi, but I’ve been having other problems too. You should know INTERNET IS REQUIRED TO VIEW VIDEOS. I deleted about 100 videos and was super excited that it freed up about seven gigabytes(the great thing about this app), but then it told me I need internet to watch my videos. Which is fine if you have access to WiFi wherever you go. Photos can still be viewed. This app would probably be a lot more enjoyable with faster internet. Videos take a while to load, plus you pretty much have to leave your device on for fifteen minutes if you want to load an app-made video. However, if you have fast internet, and internet everywhere, this is a great app.  It takes your photos and videos and makes movies, makes suggestions for albums, lets you share photos, and even has photo collages and animations from photos or a video segment. You can also make your own videos, etc., but another issue I’m having is with albums. When I try to add photos to my own album, they  don’t stay in the album. I added about 300 photos to an album and found when I reloaded the app that only three actually remained. I tried a few more times, with smaller amounts, too, but it pretty much just adds whatever it wants. I guess it’s more of a summarizing thing. If it makes an album of a certain day or vacation, (yes, it’s knows you went on vacation), it only takes certain photos in an album.  There are many advantages to this app also.  Your photos can be accessed from the internet (but not by anyone else!), and there are bonuses. One bonus is what’s called Google Lens. It scans a photo of almost anything, a map, a landmark, an old car, tells you what it is, and looks up information about it on the internet!  So all in all, it’s a pretty great app. Especially with a good internet service. 🙂

title: Google Photos has made me a happier person.
content: Google Photos has made me a happier person.. This app is phenomenal in so many ways. Over the last year, I’ve uploaded ALL of my life’s photos into this app, including scanning all of my old school photos from childhood (and even photos of parents, grandparents, etc). An unexpected outcome is that because of how easy it is to find photos with this app, I actually find myself looking at old photos on the regular and enjoying the happy memories they evoke. This is an outcome that would just simply never happen if all my old photos were to have stayed in a box in my garage. In short, it would not be an exaggeration to say that using Google Photos has made me a happier person by helping me stay reminded of all the great things I’ve experienced in life.

title: Couldn’t hate it more if I tried
content: Couldn’t hate it more if I tried. This app is an absolute nightmare. I thought it would be an easy way to get some extra photo storage since I was running out on my iPhone. NOPE. First of all, it doesn’t let you move *some* photos. It literally forces you to move all of them or you simply cannot access the app. Then if you try to delete some from google photos, it will delete the original from your device as well if you don’t turn the sync off first, and I’m genuinely unsure why anyone would want that to be the default. THEN I ran out of google storage, just like apple storage, and tried to simply undo the whole thing and buy more iCloud storage. Easier said than done. I had to read a bunch of confusing help articles to try to figure out how to delete my photos ONLY from the google photos app and not entirely. AND THEN there is no easy way to bulk delete the photos from the app so it is taking a small eternity to delete them. 0/10 would not recommend.

title: It is so helpful! 👍
content: It is so helpful! 👍. Google photos is the best app to take care of your photos. It makes movies of fun times,  helps you manage your space and it’s all in one place. You can assign people to pictures and then you can look up pictures by picking on their profile which makes it easier picking out you profile pics for friends and family while also being helpful if you want to just look at specific pictures of someone it’s all in one place. I definitely recommend this app. And by the way I am just a normal person who doesn’t pay stuff for apps and is always struggling finding good apps and games that work and fit your needs, so I’m not that bias person who likes stuff just because they bought the premium.

title: Best app to backup pictures
content: Best app to backup pictures. I LOVE that you can choose unlimited storage for free - I wouldn't use the app otherwise. The quality is also fantastic considering the fact you're not paying for the higher resolution backup (which is available). This is my go to app as I take a lot of pictures on my phone and I don't have the space to hold all of them + videos. I love how I can also backup pictures from any other device by logging in to my account and it automatically sorts the pictures by their dates & months so it's super easy to scroll through your history. I also find it a nice touch that when you upload similar pictures the Assistant will create cute animation gifs of your pictures and you can fix the lighting with one touch in some of your darker pictures!

title: Risk losing all your photos and screwing up your gmail
content: Risk losing all your photos and screwing up your gmail. I thought this app might make it a tad easier to share photos with family who don’t have iPhones. The problem is that the Google App tricks you into accessing all your photos and backing up your photos in the app. But it’s not just backing up the photos you add to the app.  Somehow, Google photos also goes into Apple iCloud and uploads ALL the photos you have stored there into google!! How are there not privacy restrictions or firewalls between the two companies is beyond me. Now I CANNOT DELETE PHOTOS FROM THE GOOGLE PHOTO APP WITHOUT IT DELETING THE PHOTOS FROM MY PHONE AND ICLOUD!!  This was not something I intentionally sanctioned!!! Furthermore now it’s saying my storage is full on gmail so I will stop receiving emails unless I pay for more storage which I don’t want to do because I already pay for apple storage.  I can’t even simply delete the app. What a mess.  Now I have to spend hours I don’t have trying to hack a way to fix this. Google does not currently offer a solution.  DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS APP TO YOUR IPHONE.

title: Neck and Neck with Apple
content: Neck and Neck with Apple. The only reason I don’t switch completely is because they each do things wonderfully. As a neutral (Win/Mac)user, I have Macs, Win10s, and Chromebooks all working together because of these two titans... oh and Microsoft. 🤣 Easy to forget.. I kid🙄 Google Photos is incrediblely awesome in its own right. Even using standards such as depth and focal that interoperate with my iPhones photos... it’s just refreshing. The sharing capabilites and the integration with my family on Google Fi is just incredible. It’s what, when I was 8, I had always visioned I would be able to do in the future, share images in realtime across the world and even space. It’s good to be alive, just wish I will be here in 100 years to see what wonders will have been created. 🎆☮️🙏

title: Convenient, but Sometimes Annoying
content:
Convenient, but Sometimes Annoying. It's very nice that I no longer have to back up my photos to my computer, but I don't like the fact that if I back up my photos in "original" quality, than it takes up space on my Google Drive and Gmail. It also has several random things that it won't back up, even though it's a perfectly normal photo. 
Some things I do like, though, is that it can make animations for you, or stitch photos together to make a panorama, or make movies and albums, all automatically, and the. You can just save it if you like it. You can also easily search your photos by keyword or date to easily find what you're looking for so you don't have to go scrolling through everything.
Overall, I'm very pleased with the product, and it's probably the most useful app on my phone that I've downloaded.

title: Do Not Use with iPhone!!!!!
content: Do Not Use with iPhone!!!!!. This application when downloaded onto your iOS device will attempt to back up automatically every single photo and video you have saved on both your device and an iCloud Drive, and it clogs up Google Drive filling it up, creating an endless loop of prompts to buy more storage and through the app I tried to download 7000 photos of my iCloud Drive on my Google Drive clog it up. It would let me delete 30 photos at a time and never substantially reduce the maxed out state of my Google Drive and then when I try to delete the photos of my Google Drive. It wants to automatically delete them on my phone on my iCloud. What the hell is this!!! This is a trap designed to trick consumers into buying Google memory space by overloading and duplicating what you already have on your phone and on your iPad making Google photos basically unusable for an iOS device user do not download. Do not download. Do not download or install on your phone!!!!!!!!!!

title: This App Surprised Me
content:
This App Surprised Me. I loved that I could backup unlimited photos, but today I got on and Google Photos had pieced together 10 albums from the last year of trips my family had been on, and made a few cheesy collages and slideshows (yet they genuinely brought a few tears to my eyes) based off of the face recognition, locations, and dates. I'm a sentimental dad who doesn't take photos or keep any souvenirs of the past. For the first time in my life, I wished that I had taken more photos in the last year. Not so I could post them on social media, but because suddenly I knew that they would be auto-sorted and labeled for me.

Basically, I let my phone sync thousands of photos to google this week, and suddenly I have well organized albums and collages. Google did the hard work for me.

title: Definite Help to storage problems and more
content: Definite Help to storage problems and more. Well, to start off I was having storage problems and the choice was to either buy more storage, or find some app that’ll store things for me and boy am I glad I picked the cheaper option Google photos might be the best app they’ve ever made tbh. Not only does it help with storage but the apps little helper has this program in which it puts together pictures and either makes a collage based on date and/or people in the picture or makes an animation based off of pictures taken in a row to the point to where it looks like it’s moving though some may believe it’s kinda intrusive but I’d rather this over literally any app because now I can delete the app and still have the pictures on google and all i have to do is sign in.👍

title: Decent app but poor notifications
content: Decent app but poor notifications. We use this app to share family photos with distant relatives. In the last few months an update was made that completely messed up how notifications work. The shared albums allow you to post comments and have fun conversations about a photo and it used to let you know when a new photo was shared and/or commented on by another member of the album. That functionality is gone. It has become quite frustrating to have a Great Grandma miss stuff because no alert was given that a new photo of her great grandkids was shared.  Or that someone asks a question only to have to wait a week to get an answer because the question didn’t prompt the right person to take a look. If notifications would get fixed our app involvement and interactions would increase drastically just as it dropped off drastically once they were crippled by an update.

title: Good App, But A Few Limitations
content: Good App, But A Few Limitations. Okay. So, this app doesn’t get a lot of popularity, but it’s a good app for photo storage and if you want an extra backup in case your cloud storage goes awry. But I wish it would stop prompting me to clear out my entire photo library - that is annoying, and I want to share photos with people who don’t have Google accounts, so it’s kind of limiting me. I love how it gives you unlimited high-quality photo storage, but I think that’s just another stunt to get you to clear your entire photo library - I mean, seriously. The app takes up a relatively small amount of space compared to my actual iCloud library, but I have a small amount of photos - only 800, and I’ve been using Apple Photos for a couple of years! All in all, a good app, but the constant pestering to delete my entire photo library made this a 4-star review.

title: The best photo app for this Mom!
content: The best photo app for this Mom!. With 4 kids - well adults actually - in 4 different cities, Google Photos is the best way to store, organize, share and edit photos. With it’s “on this date” feature, a quick collage will pop up from your timeline that you can instantly share with family and friends. Those shared memories are so important to staying connected. Also it makes photos so easy to find on the timeline with the slide bar. It doesn’t matter which device you are currently using, you can find your photos quickly anywhere and share to many apps/programs or to edit. After using many other photo organizing apps including Adobe, this is the most streamlined, user friendly app. I looooove Google Photos.

title: Great app!
content:
Great app!. The best cloud storage for photos! It automagically backs up every photo on my mobile devices. And it’s free! With a small caveat.... the photos have to be under a certain size. That’s not a problem since I’m not aware of a cell phone that exceeds those size limitations with the possible exception of panoramas. 

That alone would be a killer feature, but the goodies don’t stop there. Once in the cloud The Goog sorts the photos in a number of ways, if you allow them to they’ll recognize your people so you can search for a photo of a particular person. It will make animations of sequential photos so you get a time lapse of a given event. 

You can even edit your photos with filters or automagically and I’m pretty impressed by how good they are (I’m not usually a fan of auto modes for photography).

title: Google photos is the best there is
content: Google photos is the best there is. When it comes to photo saving/storage you will not find a better app than Google photos. You're always guaranteed you're photos are safe, protected and stored properly. There is unlimited storage that you can't find anywhere else, especially when it comes to unlimited Photo storage that is free. With Google Chrome, your storage photos are at your fingertips anytime you want them. itother cannot be Google photos When it comes to Moments, that app has not worked great for me since the beginning, I have not liked what so ever and it's not at all what they thought it was going to be. Thank you Google photos for being the best number one at what you do and being there for us. Rhonda Holland

title: This is my #1 atorage and complete trust over my files ,photo albums & My LIFE ;)
content: This is my #1 atorage and complete trust over my files ,photo albums & My LIFE ;). This is always up to date to give you the best storage ability and designed to fit everyone’s individual needs such as google photos I have used it now for so many years I honestly can’t remember , GUESS WHAT google automatically separates each face into its own photo album for there self that you ever take a photo and save to account and you also have diffremt albums set up for memories yearly Highlights it gives you almost any benifit you could imagine trust me Google never lets you down there opportunities it will give you is endless if you just ask and guide your way to allow them to help follow out any Dream Task or Mission you may have or encounter

title: Great with a few major issues
content:
Great with a few major issues. I love the app even though I have to pay for storage. I really like that Google’s AI let’s me search for specific faces or things in a particular photo, it’s very useful. The pictures seem to load quickly when you need them. 

I dislike that photos download onto a computer as .heic files and I wish there was a way to change this so they would download as JPEGs. It’s disappointing that there’s no locked or private album feature, similar to Apple’s hidden photos. 
The biggest issue I continue to run into with the app, however, is that it just won’t delete photos sometimes. No matter how many times I go into the app, delete a batch of photos, and even empty the app trash, they continue to come back. I’ve closed and restarted the app over and over again trying to delete photos but nothing works. I know it’s not a syncing issue between my devices because the photos are deleted from my phone and I don’t have any other devices connected to my Google Photos account. The same photos I’ve deleted many times over continue to show up in my app. 

This is a major flaw, it’s very annoying, and it makes an otherwise great app lose at least a star for me.

title: Almost necessary feature missing!
content:
Almost necessary feature missing!. I like the app! It’s nice. It syncs incredibly fast and for someone who needs my photos on both my laptop and phone it’s wonderful, considering iPhone’s small iCloud size (it stops updating on the pc end when full) so I’m very thankful for this!

However. There is a necessary feature that’s missing. Album syncing. I don’t believe it would be that incredibly hard to implement, as Google photos has already included the ability to sync favorites—so, wheres the album coverage? I put a lot of my photos into albums and having to re-put them back is extremely tedious, especially considering I can do it with one click for favorites. 

If this feature is added, I’ll 100% come back and change the rating to 5 stars, as that seems deserving!

title: Real Estate Appraiser
content: Real Estate Appraiser. I love this app. I am a real estate appraiser. Myself and my team use this app and I can’t say enough about how great it is. Use the app specifically for my comparable photos. I made the switch from using SD cards (digital camera) to iCloud and now Google Photos. For me it’s an efficiency thing. My time = money. It is that simple. You don’t have to be good at tech stuff AND it’s smart and shows you where the photo was taken if you can’t remember what property you photographed. Of all the apps I’ve ever reviewed this one is literally the best. It’s easy to use if one of my computer and smart phone illiterate employees can use it anyone can.  And on top of that the extra-storage is affordable, and the other built in features are way above my expectations.

title: 6 years and no complaints
content:
6 years and no complaints. Obviously no app is perfect; however, this app has came the closest app to perfect for me. I have had this app for almost 6 years. I've been able to see how my life and friendships have changed over those last 6 years. I have kept almost every photo that I have taken of my loved ones and whenever I am sad, I am able to look back on those memories.

There is limited space without pay which is why I upgraded. However, that limited space is enough for most people. I may be a memory hoarder though. I have over 50,000 photos saved on here yet I still am not even close to having all my storage filled. Also, it's at a low cost. I believe $2-$3/month for 1 tb! That's a really good deal for what this app offers.

Not only that, but they have a system which organizes certain faces into their own category. Whenever I want to see the progess of a certain person, I just go there and see. It's amazing how I've seen so much of my family and myself grow and change over the years.

If you're looking for a photo gallery that will help you save space on your phone or computer, organize faces, and give you memories to reminisce on, this app is the one for you!

title: overall great app
content: overall great app. i had about 47 GB worth of photos on my phone to where it was filling up most of my storage, so google photos helped out SO MUCH with having it be able to take away the amount of storage taken up. however, the only problems i had with it was that there were a lot of photos out of place than where they were normally on my photos app so i would have to search around for it instead of knowing where it usually was. the other thing was that i had a lot of my photos either in a specific album or my “favorites” but that doesn’t transfer over to google photos which causes me to have to go through and select them all again, which took quite a lot of time. if i were to suggest something, it would just mainly be for those two things, otherwise it is an overall great app!

title: Best photo app and storage available. More importantly I think Google will be around for awhile.
content:
Best photo app and storage available. More importantly I think Google will be around for awhile.. After using various startups to store my photos and videos in the cloud I find Googles app to be the best. Many of the startup, while developing elegant platforms have failed...wasting my time and money in the long run.  I am somewhat of an Apple fanboy, but their approach and solutions are sorely lacking. 

Google has better data search, facial recognition and interface. Google's "Assistant" is well done and adds much value. All of these services fail at deduping properly. Can someone please get serious about solving this problem. I can't believe it's that difficult, but my guess is that it is not cost effective. All that being said I am thus far happy with this app and give it 4.75 stars...rounded up to 5. 👍

title: I recommend this app
content:
I recommend this app. This app is wonderful. I have an iPhone and I don’t think much more needs to be said about why I need this app. 

The only issue I had was easily and quickly resolved with a quick Google search. The issue I had was that when the app was finished backing up my photos, I’d go to free up space and the number of items to delete wasn’t the same amount of photos I had in my phone’s “photos.” I assumed it was because the files were too big but I didn’t know how to change that. Google told me the steps for this which are: open the app-assistant-drop down menu-settings [top righthand corner]-back up & sync-upload size-original. 

When you select original size, it will tell you that doing this will go against your quota. I selected “original size” anyway but did not notice a change in storage space within the app. Obviously this resolved my issue and it was not difficult to find a guide for doing so. 

I only use this app so I CAN have space on my phone and don’t really use it for anything else but I do like a lot of the features you see when you open the app. 

I recommend this app all the time and will continue to do so because it has impressed me a lot.

title: Some issues
content:
Some issues. App seems to stop working when after a few min my phone screen goes dark. Also, photos take a long time to upload. Both of these may be caused by my slow and often unreliable internet. 
What is definitely the app's trait, though, is that when I check on the upload status, the count will often be back where it started, even though there was a steadily decreasing number when I looked between the re-starting (remember, it seems to stop for no reason) and the check.
I don't like it when it indicates a certain number of photos uploaded and then asks if I'd like to save space on my phone and delete some, only giving me a choice of all or cancelling, without an option to view/select individual pics. 

In all fairness, some of the above may be iPhone quirks since my son (a droid user) loves and suggested the app (and/or he doesn't care if it deletes without showing picssince he can view/get them later).

title: Great peace of mind..
content:
Great peace of mind... I don't usually leave app reviews but I needed to leave a review for this one. Google photos is a great idea and in case something misfortunate happens, can be a life saver. I know some people are afraid of "big brother" and don't want their photos uploaded but to me it would be much worse to lose all my great memories because something happened to my phone along the way. Their are other services out there which do the same thing but you must pay a monthly fee to keep your photos there.

I just came back from a two week family vacation to see my family roots. My parents have not been back to their country in 30+ years and Google backed up my photos every night through out our trip - a piece of mind that you can't put a price on.

Thanks Google.

title: Would like better UX around making albums and removing pics
content:
Would like better UX around making albums and removing pics. This is a great app, and I have entrusted it with all my family photos. While it is great for syncing photos, it could be better in a couple ways. 

First, building albums. I’m one of those people who likes to sort and categorize my media. This applies to family photos especially. In the current photos UI there is little visibility around which photos are in albums, and which albums are they in.

Second, there’s the workflow around culling photos. It is a common practice to take bursts of photos and then go back later and remove all but a few. You don’t need twelve pictures of somebody blowing out birthday candles, you just want the one good one that is in focus and where people’s faces aren’t frozen in some sort of seizure pose. The UX for removing the bad pics could be much better.

title: Continuously Improving
content:
Continuously Improving. Google Photos is an ever-evolving app that consistently pushes the boundaries of what a photo management and sharing platform can do. With each update, it brings new features, enhancements, and optimizations, making it a top choice for users seeking a versatile photo app.

Pros:

	1.	AI Magic: Google’s powerful AI algorithms automatically categorize, tag, and organize your photos, making it incredibly easy to find specific moments in your collection.
	2.	Storage Options: The generous free storage for high-quality photos and videos is a standout feature, especially for those with limited device space.
	3.	Seamless Sharing: Sharing albums and photos with friends and family is a breeze, and the collaborative features make it perfect for events and group projects.
	4.	Search Capabilities: Google Photos’ search functionality is a game-changer, allowing you to find photos by entering descriptive terms or even object recognition.
	5.	Editing Tools: The app’s built-in editing tools are handy for quick adjustments, and it even offers suggestions for enhancing your photos automatically.

Cons:

	1.	Privacy Concerns: Users should be mindful of the potential privacy implications of Google Photos, as it relies heavily on Google’s AI, which may raise data security concerns for some.
	2.	Changes in Free Storage: Be aware of Google’s storage policy changes, as they have evolved over time. This could impact how you manage your photos and videos.

“Continuously Improving” is a fitting review title for an app that never stops getting better. Its robust feature set, AI-powered organization, and seamless sharing capabilities make it an invaluable tool for managing your precious memories. However, potential privacy and storage concerns should be kept in mind while using the app.

title: New search tool blocks you from accessing your own photos
content:
New search tool blocks you from accessing your own photos. The search tool doesn’t work anymore for people in healthcare. I am a pathologist studying for hemepath boards, so I have a lot of photos of notes I take during didactics. This used to be the best app for searching through old photos. Recent updates have been so bizarrely paternalistic that it will block access to your own photos and claim you’re [seemingly] not smart enough to look at them. Yes, your own photos. 

I am not joking. 

Both vague medical terms like “liver pathology” or specific terms like “hepatocellular carcinoma” will provide no results and trigger the AI search function instead. The AI will then tell me that it can’t diagnose health conditions and I should talk to a doctor, despite me already being a doctor, blatantly not asking any medical question, and simply trying to search study material within my OWN PHOTOS. There is no option to do a normal search anymore without the Google gods triaging your photos.

title: Great photo storage
content:
Great photo storage. Love the free photo storage. If you already have a gmail/Google account there is no reason to not utilize Google photos.
I love that you can “free up space” by deleting g your photos that are already uploaded that way you always have room to take more pictures! No more annoying “low storage” warning. 
You can also edit your photos, and make animations with photos and videos which is a rad feature.
The app has face recognition so you can label and group together pictures of the same person and easily search for them by name/whatever you labeled then as. Some examples are like if you wanted to see all the sunset photos you have, you would search “sunset” and they would all come up. You can do it with people too once you go through and label them which is super convenient.
I love being able to organize my photos by album- and speaking of albums, the app creates little albums for you for certain dates or events that it thinks you may want to see. It’s neat to see what the app chooses and “thinks” you might want to see put into an album. 
There are so many other features on this app too- to many to list.

title: Google Photos lost my photos... not a reliable service or app
content:
Google Photos lost my photos... not a reliable service or app. I first started using Google Photos when I bought a Pixel 2 phone. Loved it! I immediately loaded Google Photos on to my iPhone and finally had an app and cloud service that seamlessly integrated my iPhone pix and Pixel 2 pix. So far so good...

Fast forward 18 months... was cleaning up my photos during self-quarantine and noticed that many, many photos taken on Pixel 2 phone are now missing from Google Photos. My trip to Vienna and Venice, perhaps only 25% of photos remained; ditto for my trips to NYC, Pittsburgh, Seattle, San Francisco, LA, Tokyo. All the great memories are now gone/missing. Ironically, all my iPhone photos that are backed up on Google Photos are still there!

Searched online and found many people with similar experiences and all said Google support was no help. I too reached out to Google support and find their help so far to be useless: all cut and paste suggestions such as did you check archive and trash? Did you log into Google Photos under another account...etc. 

Frankly, I am very disappointed at Google’s callousness and lack of responsiveness to this problem given how important photos are to everyone.

Our photos are our memories, our emotional connections to places, people, time, events, and experiences. Memories make us human and define who we are; you can lose my emails but you can’t lose our memories.

title: WORST APP EVER
content: WORST APP EVER. I’ve been using this app since around 2016 and it has been great, it has backed up all my photos and videos pretty well and I haven’t had a problem with it. However, my phone has been having issues with storage and had to delete some apps for storage. So I deleted google photos temporarily as from past experience I deleted the app and when I reinstalled it all the photos were still there. So when I deleted the app and got storage a couple days later, I reinstalled the app. I logged in with the gmail account that I always have been using for the app, and when I opened it, all the photos/videos from 2016 were gone and the only photos/videos on the app were the ones from my camera roll, which are only from 2018. Most of my photos/videos I backed up onto Google Photos and now they’re all just GONE!!! Do something about this because now all my memories are gone because of you all and it made me cry. I will sue your company if you don’t bring me back my photos/videos. Thanks 😘

title: Amazing Service Until Recent Update
content:
Amazing Service Until Recent Update. I have been using Google Photos for years. It’s the best photo service around. I love the fact that you can archive photos after sorting them. It’s super easy to share, sort, download, and see all your photos. My family all uses Google Photos so we can easily share albums with each other. I even pay for more storage, that’s how much I love this app. 

However, after the newest updates I want to cancel my subscription and find something else. I HATE how all my albums are now under “Collections” instead of being in their own tab like they used to. I HATE the fact that when I go to add photos to an album, it used to be in order by the album that was edited most recently, now it’s random with all my shared albums being at the bottom. So now I have to scroll through my list of a million albums just to find the one I’m looking for. It’s made photo sorting so much harder. I wish I had never updated the app.

title: Will outright refuse to work unless you let Google have every single photo
content:
Will outright refuse to work unless you let Google have every single photo. The app artificially refuses to work unless you give it UNLIMITED access to every photo in your camera roll. Giving it limited access to only the subset of photos you want Google to have won’t satisfy it, Google wants to vacuum up and data mine every photo you have ever taken, or you don’t get the app. Even if you upload photos on another device or the web, it will refuse to work unless it can access all photos on your current device.
 
There’s no technical reason for this, a photo library/editor app could just as easily work on some of your photos as it could on all of your photos. This is an artificial limitation put in place because Google wants ALL of your information, and will try to strong-arm you into giving them it. This is like Dropbox refusing to let you see your documents unless you give it access to every file you've ever created.

title: Love this app💯
content:
Love this app💯. I seriously love this app! It allows me the ability to be able to store ALL my pictures & videos in 1 place so that I don’t have to search & wonder where I stored this photo or that video, also it allows me to store them somewhere besides my phone, & that way I have all the space on my phone I need! I would DEFINITELY RECOMMEND this app to anyone that wants to keep all the sentimental photos & videos they want & love. Besides having to delete them, because you’ve ran out of space. You can also make different albums to separate them the way you want & put titles on the albums! 
Example:{ Baby’s 1st Birthday} You can add different people to your collection & name that person too! There’s just so much google photos offer & again I’d advise you to at least try this app!

title: Google is our friend!
content:
Google is our friend!. There are so many things that could be mentioned about the amazing work Google creats everyday to make life easier for us, that makes it hard to express how wonderful it really is to be able to solve problems quick and officiant. Google photos is pretty amazing overall except of one thing. I usually have a hard time having access to my photos IF, I, for instance need to upload A photo onto a certain website! In other words if I am in need of dragging a file onto a website. I wish I could get some help to find out weather I'll have to download all my photos one by one on my device and then choose a file to upload or are there other solutions available as well that I'm not aware of! .
Thank you Google as always

title: Not impressed
content: Not impressed. I ended up getting Google photos by mistake. Someone shared a Google photo album with me, and all of the sudden The only emails that I get are to tell me that my storage is almost full and I may not receive emails. I never signed up for all of my photos from my phone to be pulled into my google account. Further I have a few Google email addresses, one for work, and another one for personal use. However Google Photos decided to attach to all of my Google email addresses. When I try to manage my storage, I do not see an option where I can just completely eliminate having Google photos attached to my new email address. It is frustrating to not know if I am not receiving emails because my storage is almost full, or if I’m just not receiving emails. No matter how often I try to delete several Google photos, it seems like I can never just delete them all. In theory it sounds like a really great program, in practice I cannot stand it.

title: Love it to pieces. Only wished it was a flat fee!!!
content: Love it to pieces. Only wished it was a flat fee!!!. I can't say much beyond what people have raved about this app. It's absolutely great. It's instantaneous. It's easy. It's dependable... for the most part.  I have lost edited Assistant Movies on several occasions. It creates really awesome movies capturing a day or week of events and even adds in playful music. You can edit them by changing the song, what vids and pics you want to include, and other fun details. But it also crashes by not saving movies when you try to select the segment of the video you want; e.g. It may choose 4 sec of the end of a video and you may prefer 12 sec from the beginning. It crashes all the time when you try to save your edits. The other thing is to honor your customers by allowing them to do a one-time purchase of an allotted storage size versus month to month charges.

title: Google
content: Google. I lovvvvveeee this so much! It have never crashed OR glitches!! It saves all my photos so I can free up space on my REAL photo storage app!! I have been using this app and it creates videos with lots of picks AND it makes animations!! ITS AWESOME!! I can take more photos and keep them all! I have like 3 hour long videos AND IT SAVES!!! NO GLITCHES OR ANYTHING!! I love it you you should get it! Never have to buy ICloud or all that! (I think?) it literally saved me AND kept ALL my photos and now I can take more! It also has a button you can click to delete all the photos, videos, etcetera on your “normal photos” that have ALREADY been saved on this app!! You should DEFINITELY get it! Bets part is... ITS FREE!! WORTH ALL 5 STARS!! YOU WILL NOT LOSE ANY OF YOUE PHOTOS!!! Get this app!! It will help you so much!!

title: I love this very much
content: I love this very much. I think this is a great app if you own a apple product that makes it so you have very limited photo space. I spent hours trying to figure out how to get rid of my least important pictures to get more space on my IPad. After deleting half of my picture my storage was still full. After I got this app it backed up all my photos and showed me how to free up the space on my IPad. I kid you not, I now have 10 extra GB to use! It is great to know that this app doesn’t want to take your money for more space and it gives me cute animations, styled photos, and slide shows that look really nice. You can still have an organized system which it great for me. If you have an apple and don’t want to pay for extra storage this is a GREAT app to get. Highly recommend

title: Amazing App!
content: Amazing App!. I got this app because my phone was completely out of storage. I had over 2,500 photos and I didn’t want any to delete them all. I started looking into buying more iCloud space, but then I came across Google Photos, and let me tell you, this app is a blessing. When I first started uploading my pictures I was afraid of deleting them from the Photos app in case Google Photos didn’t work or something happened, but eventually I deleted them all, and I’m so happy I did. Google Photos takes up much less space, all my pictures are safe, and you can edit your photos in the app. My favorite thing about Google Photos is the assistant tab, it suggests changes to pictures, collages to make, and many other cool things. I would 100% recommend this app!

title: Seriously the best!
content: Seriously the best!. First of all I never rate apps but this one is exactly what I was looking for!  I needed to remove photos from my phone but didn’t want to because then I’d have to go to my computer to look at them. This app allowed me to remove them off my phone but still keep them on my phone!  I freed up 10GB of data using this app. It does an amazing job sorting your photos, making albums and keeping all your pics right at your fingertips!  The only thing you should know is that is can take days to back up all your photos if you had a lot like me. Other than that once they are all backed up it takes no time to stay on top of backing up your photos.  It was able to recognize my dogs, friends, family, places, things etc. super awesome app!  Thanks!

title: Why Google Photos is good
content: Why Google Photos is good. Nice work on “Google Photos”. This app is a very good app for people to use. One reason why is because you can do a lot more things then the regular “Photos”. Second reason why is because it saves your pictures and keeps it on your google account which you can log in anytime which is amazing, now you can delete all your picture from “Photos” but not “Google Photos” and its all not gone (unless you didn’t back it up). Last reason why it’s amazing is because it save you a lot and I mean a lot of memory. This app would save 80% of what my “Photos” app took up. Because of this app I can do a lot more things without worrying about my memory with all the picture that I have. Thanks for all the good work for everyone, good up the great work 👍🏻

title: Be aware
content:
Be aware. The app is good in that it backs up your photos but it runs in the background and I didn't realize but it ate all my data even though I was connected to wifi. Had to turn off cellular usage which means it won't work if not connected to wifi. Also, I was low on my phone storage capacity and it freed space for me but then it creates animation and photo collage and I find the storage unstable ( an example is I free storage by deleting backup photos and when it loads check my storage it will show I have 10 GB of free space the next day I'll get a message that I am low on space again and need to free more storage it will turn out I have less than 1 GB 
I'm afraid to delete the app and loose all the photos that already backed up

title: Warning! Read before purchasing cloud space
content:
Warning! Read before purchasing cloud space. If you choose to upload full resolution and purchase monthly storage space:
 do NOT use a google email address that is important to you. If you later choose to not keep the full resolution versions and their monthly cost, you’ll loose your precious email address because you can’t keep it and not pay for the original photos you’ve uploaded. In order to keep your original email intact and If you have hundreds of gb of photos uploaded, you’ll have to TEDIOUSLY DELETE each file or small groups of files until you’re down to less than the 15gb maximum. Who has time for that??
In this situation, Google has chosen not to make it simple for paying customers to change their mind unless you delete the entire account; email and all. 
Amrikan Kapitalism at it’s finest. Easy to get in. Painful to get out. (Unless you’ve created a “Photos only” email address you don’t care about loosing)

title: Way better than iPhotos
content:
Way better than iPhotos. This app is really fantastic. Once it gets all of your photos uploaded, which can take a while, it is a great backup for them. They are stored in the original format and are organized chronologically starting at the top. (Takes a day or two to get used to that change.) they are on Googles secure servers. Storage is unlimited, you don't need to pay for some extra features, like "Prime" and it is really easy to share photos or whole albums with family.  

Can't say enough about the ease of use. Whenever you take a picture on your phone, iPad or connected camera, the photos automatically upload and are stored. There is even a built in app to help clear space on your phone memory. 

By the way, did I mention that all of this I'd free!!!

title: Really annoying it forces full access to use
content:
Really annoying it forces full access to use. I accidentally gave Google Photos access to my full album because I wanted to share 3 pictures with someone in their Google shared library and it backed up all of my photos to Google, taking up all of my Google drive space. I get notifications that I have memories but when I open the notification I’m met with a screen that says Google Photo REQUIRES FULL ACCESS to my photos and then it won’t show me anything. I don’t want Google to back up my photos but there is no option unless I give it full access. I’ve had issues with image privacy and Google in the past, so I do not want to share access. It also does not easily allow me to remove all of the images that it has uploaded.

Overall unless you’re deep in the Google ecosystem and want to share your images to Google (to be used for marketing if they desire), I would not install this app. I want to remove it but need to clear my images.

title: Great
content: Great. I love how it give suggestions and that it shows you what those suggestions are. I like that I’m able to save them. It’s been a great app so far. I just wish that it would download all the videos on my photo stream to the app. I am unable to delete all my photos and videos from my phone in fear that they are not all saved. They should allow unlimited storage for photos. Or group all the same/similar photos to go to a folder in utilities similar/duplicate so it’s easier to go through and clean your photos. And this will reduce the amount of storage used. The apps to clean your devices are untrustworthy. Or you phone can prompt you, that you’ve taken several similar photos which ones would you like to keep. It’s easier for a program to do this for than having someone sit hours on a computer going through photos that could already be grouped. And I don’t mean archived!

title: Helpful but Not
content: Helpful but Not. I used google photos essentially as an archive. putting ONLY photos there that I didn't want to keep on my phone. However, when I got the app, everything automatically began syncing. For some, this is amazing, you clear the camera roll and whatever else. This is most likely everyone's intended use, however it is not mine. I had no problem continuing using google photos however I needed the sync to stop. I am someone who uses photos often, edits, crops, makes multiple changes, have several drafts, and for each one to be saved to later then delete is just exhausting. I looked up how to turn this off and although I have backup and sync off, it still continues. I am now out of space and can not do things with google that I need to do, UNLESS I pay for more storage but I don't need 100 GB for I am not using google photos that way. This issue is just exhausting.

title: It Just Won’t Work!
content: It Just Won’t Work!. I am trying to create a shared album for a family trip we took over the weekend to share the photos with the family, and there are so many issues! First, it wouldn’t let me upload the photos to where I could share them. I went to share and it popped up with a screen informing me it was saving recent changes. I let that stay there for fifteen minutes and it did absolutely nothing. When I tried to share the link, my boyfriend said the album was empty. So I reuploaded ALL of the photos, and he STILL says the album is empty. When I went back into it, I found that there was at least one missing image, which is the MAIN IMAGE I am trying to send! When I went to upload it, it didn’t even show up in the list of photos that I could upload from, so I had to duplicate the photo in my personal album, and that allowed it to show up. However, when I went to upload it, it went to an “uploading file” screen and won’t actually upload the ONE photo!

title: Great app!
content:
Great app!. I have found Google Photos to be very helpful with my picture storage. It has allowed me to keep hundreds of photos (with high quality!) that I would not have been able to save otherwise.

My only concern is that of a certain quality that is ignored in the account-linking feature and could hopefully be added one day. When you transfer photos from one account to the next through linking accounts, you have to take new pictures of people (after changing the backup settings) just to have them shown in the "People" (also "Things", "Places", etc.) category on your other account. If not, then those folders will never include them.

Other than that, this is a very useful application to have and I suggest you try it out!

title: Amazing
content: Amazing. I’ve never reviewed an app before but google photos is so perfect, I just had to. Everything is automatically saved which is so convenient. I get notifications about photos I took a year or two ago and I have a 2 year old so these make me cry every time. The app also makes photo collages and videos on its own and then sends me notifications about them. My favorite is a video that it made that is actually made up of a few videos I took on my phone of my daughter. It went in chronological order so the first video it pulled from was from when she was about two months old and it ended with one that I took a few days before the app put everything together. It was set to beautiful music and I’ve showed everyone and cried every time.

title: Really not needed
content: Really not needed. I downloaded this app so I can get photos from my google drive on to Shutterfly. Besides for the fact that it didn’t work it just filled my google account. With all the photos that are on my phone. I already pay for iCloud storage and they want me to pay for google storage as well. So I deleted the photos from the app to free up the space on my google account. However, when deleting photos from the app it does not notify you are deleting the photos from your phone entirely!! And all of them were not even in the trash anymore by the time I realized. I don’t know why as it states the pictures should be there for 40 day and this all happened today. Thank goodness iCloud did have all my deleted photos from the passed two years and I was able to restore them. I just don’t see the point in having to apps that do the same exact thing and take up space on two different servers. That’s just a waste in my opinion.

title: Privacy invader!!!
content:
Privacy invader!!!. Everyone is praising this app, it’s a good app, it has lots of organizational and creative features, but it has a huge fault: invasion of privacy. Once you install this app on your phone and start backing up your pictures from your phone’s photo app, there’s no turning back. 
I toggled off the photos’ back up & sync and the Google Photos app still backs up the photos from my phone. 
Further, whenever I delete pictures from the Google Photos app, it deletes them from my phone too. This app sticks to your phone, it gets your pictures and all the data, then you can’t delete them. They should, at least, have an option where you could choose whether to delete them from your phone or not.  It’s just unbelievable!!!
I also tried to log out from the app, just to make sure my photos don’t back up & sync anymore, after switching off the back up didn’t work, but I ran into another problem: I can’t find the log out button within the app. Then I tried to just delete the app from my phone without logging out, but I got this message saying if I delete the app, I lose all the data. 
I don’t know what to do, I feel like I’m stuck with this app, it bothers me a lot! I didn’t realize what a tight control Google has over your phone once you allow it to access your pictures.

Update: I figured out you can disallow them to access your pictures from your phone settings....but still, this should be an option available within the app. 
Still disappointed that I can’t just delete the pictures I backed up without losing them from my phone too. I’ll just save them all on a Flash drive then delete them from the app and retrieve them later from the flash.

title: Share more
content: Share more. Love the app !!! I use google sheets to run my jobs and keep up with estimates and I even have sheets I share with my men to share the job info Cool part is they can not only see the photos from my google photo album they can even upload their pics !!! It gets better I can get a call and tell the customer it will be a $300 service call - they send me a picture of the area to be repaired - I use the sheets and photos to tell my repair guy the job is on the board He calls them goes and repairs the area then uploads finished pictures and collects payment I don’t even have to get out of armchair And it’s free !!! I would pay for this service I have a lot of ideas if any of you google folks want to hear them

title: creepy smart
content: creepy smart. Once I discovered you can search your own pictures for theoretical things it was on. I probably spent 2 hours (I’m sure someone who works at Google could tell you exactly how long I spent with a few keystrokes) searching for things like: tire, cat, mirror, purple, can, art, cloud, parallelogram. Nothing short of mind blowing. Also makes gifs from photo bursts. I feel like easily making gifs from my phone elevates me from “average lurker” to “guy who could contribute to the internet maybe someday.” Aside from that it handles all the standard photo app duties as you’d expect from Google; solid processing, intuitive controls, photo editing adequate for a hobbyist, plain Jane gui lacks polish. Plays nice with Apple for the most part.

title: Lost every photo taken after years. Multiple backups gone.
content:
Lost every photo taken after years. Multiple backups gone.. I have used this app to back up photos taken on different phones, etc. For years it worked great and I could always download my old pictures onto a new device. Suddenly, over 7 years of pictures were gone with no trace - not in the trash, or archive or anywhere, and I was left with nothing other than what I had taken with my current phone. 

There is no way to resolve issues other than asking the community, which unfortunately has just told me to check my trash and prevent my question from being addressed properly. 

I wish I had known this was a possibility or I would have backed the pictures up to a hard drive. I don’t want to complain - but a backup service is exactly what this app was supposed to be, and it left me with nothing. Google will not answer anything now that everything is missing, so I’d like to warn other people of what I experienced.

title: Google Photos
content: Google Photos. I thought my photos were gone because I lost access to my account and I was so surprised and continue to be that Google found them and collaborated with my other accounts and I have +6,000 pictures. I cannot begin to express my gratitude because my photos are part of my life. Also, I love the other features within the app including the utilities, the suggestions to help my photos stay cleaned up and organized. I like how have so many choices in sharing and I really liking popping on every day to see what was created just for me. I’ve cried happy tears watching the short videos and I have been amazed at the beautiful color pop pictures. Thank you Google Photos! I have and will continue to recommend your app to everyone!

title: Confusing…
content: Confusing…. Wanted to free up space on my iPhone and google pics says that I could view my pics at any time.  But when I hit the free up space tab it said all my photos would be deleted from my iCloud!!! WHY?? Where do they go? To free up space the pics go into their clouds, right?  So if my pics are already backed up in my iCloud and no longer using space on my phone, why does google photos want to delete them from my iCloud?  My iCloud is not full, I have 2 tb on my phone and only used 15% of storage.  So I don’t get it… what I really want us to remove duplicate photos like it used to do a couple years ago. Idk what happened or if I’m just missing it, but I can’t find the tab that says remove duplicate photos like it used to have.  It was better before, whatever they did only made it harder and less helpful.

title: great app, one small thing
content: great app, one small thing. this is an overall great app, it’s so easy to save space and search for so many things with different categories. love how easy it is to select things and organize into albums and add things to albums after they are already created. there is one thing though, after having added a photo to an album, and i am going back through looking at it, if i decide i don’t want the photo backed up anymore, there is no way to delete it straight from the album. In order to delete that photo you have to go back to the main camera roll and scroll through to look for the picture which is a major waste of time. It would be very nice if there was a delete photo option while inside of an album.

title: Simply love this app
content:
Simply love this app. Was fed up of paying iCloud to store my pics, this is the best option where you can store unlimited number of pictures that too for free. 
Quality won’t be that of the original pic, but you can take the backup on hard drive or your laptop, if you need the original one and use this app to backup in slightly low quality (which you won’t be able to notice) and free some space on your mobile devices. If you need the photo on mobile simply download it. 
Best part is, the assistant it will do auto editing on backup photos such as styling, or creating collages, color popping, creating movies or albums.
Also sharing with your loved ones is so simple.
Thanks a lot for such a friendly app. Hope to see some more features.

title: Highest recommendation
content: Highest recommendation. I use this app to back up my photos in addition to iCloud Photo Library. I don't mind paying a few bucks a month to have enough space to back up my photos, but you can't beat free and unlimited. It took a very long time to upload 15 years worth of photos, but the Google photos service is amazing. This app routinely shows me photos from years and memories past, and helps dig up photos I might have never seen again. The search function only gets better over time and has made it much easier to find the photos I’m looking for. New features are slowly added that continue to make this an even more powerful service. Can not recommend this highly enough, hard to oversell this product/service.

title: Sanity-saver
content:
Sanity-saver. I take tons of pictures and screenshots throughout the day to help with tasks, as a memory aid, and to take the place of pen and paper. It drove me nuts trying to organize or worse, find a picture after I'd taken it. The facial recognition and search function are a lifesaver. 

We have dogs, and I also take a lot of pictures of other dogs. It would be awesome if somehow Google could identify individual dogs so that I could find our dogs as opposed to the bazillion screenshots of dog memes that I save from the Internet. That's the only improvement I would look for. This app is darn near perfect.

^I wrote that years ago and apparently never sent it. Since then Google has done something so we can ID our dogs! It can even identify individual dog breeds pretty well. Love it.

title: Lost photos :(
content: Lost photos :(. I have an IPhone but had run out of storage through my ICloud back in March- Long story short- my phone reset itself back to March and because of my iCloud being full, any pics or contacts added or apps downloaded were lost. I wasn’t too worried because I had the extra back-up for my pics here- for some reason, none of my pics taken after Aug 1st were saved to the google photos app. I lost 2 weeks worth of pictures into cyber space :’( In all the years I’ve had my google acct, I’ve never had any issues and absolutely love the suggested videos and editing suggestions, etc. even though I’m absolutely devastated about losing my pics from the past 2 weeks~ I would still recommend this app and will continue to use & love it.

title: Handy ;)
content: Handy ;). Other than the compressions and limits on resolution, which may change later on, this app is amazing for saving your storage and organizing them. The app also saves your iPhone content using the same categorizing Apple does when transferred to a pc (which makes sense), and this means you can delete any photos you don’t need, and simply later re-download them, without overwriting any ones you still have... I’m sorry if that’s confusing. The one and only thing that I WISH they would implement, is a world map photo phinder/finder, similar to Apple’s. I’m not trying to fanboy, I just appreciate being able to view all the places I have collected photos of, all in a nice map showing exactly where they were taken. <3 thanks google for this awesome app.

title: Simply Amazing!
content: Simply Amazing!. Google photos is simply amazing.  Not only does it quickly and safely store all of my photos, the Assistant function is awesome.  Face recognition allows me to instantly view every photo of any individual that I ever took a photo of.  The search function is equally great.  For instance type in the word 'dog' and you immediately access every photo you ever took that has a dog in it.  The movie function also enables you to create your own movies or edit the ones Google creates for you.  Google certainly hit a home run with this app.  I have over 35,000 photos stored and use this app daily.  I just took 1200 photos at Disneyworld and organized them in albums for easy viewing and sharing.  Again, simply amazing!

title: Best Photo storage app ever
content:
Best Photo storage app ever. Being an iPhone user for the past 7 years, I don't fancy the icloud for photos. Google photos is the best and works rather well in people identification as well as location. I like the fact that it shows the photos on the map as well as the route I took to travel. Some may say its intrusion of privacy, but Google has given you the choice to decide it. I opted in and like the feature! 
Also the images are stored in the best quality mode when you take a backup. I can literally go 10 years backwards and still get the quality of image that was taken then. Not all cloud storage for photos are good, but Google deserves the credit for building this largely underrated app!

title: Just Great!
content: Just Great!. So Google got me to use it over iPhoto because of several reasons.  One, they were first to the punch on "search pictures by content", which works great! Two, because they offer free storage (albeit at a compressed quality) and having my first kid meant lots of pictures are going to be taken. Third, and most importantly, the ease of "aggregation" of all my pictures from different sources. This is a dream once you have it all setup up. I also love the shared albums you can create, which have worked out well as I have one album shared to my entire family with all the pics of my son.  Now everyone always has access to pics of my son. And, now that they have added the ability to share your ENTIRE library with someone else (my wife of course) it is perfect for what I needed. Highly recommended for families.

title: I hate your update!
content:
I hate your update!. It is cluttered and no longer functional for me ! You changed the entire lay out ! No separation between months with highlights of the month above - now it's just a little bar when you are scrolling.  I absolutely hate it ! I have no use for this any longer. I will be canceling my google storage account - and finding another app that is user friendly and one that I can actually find my photos . This update is garbage ! I don't remember exact dates of photos saved - I spend half a day searching for a particular photo ?! I'm not paying for something I can't use ! Major mistake! The design is terrible! It is a total and complete cluster @&$*ing mess ! Good bye to all the monthly memories that were above each month ! Perhaps we may have wanted to have kept those ! Im so  mad ! After years and years of saving photos - I can't find anything ! I don't like it at all and it seems I'm not alone in this ! I'm angry ! I'm completely devastated it's not organized anymore- it's just a non stop scroll of pictures with no real context or dates - it's like a run on instagram ! I have one of those already! I can not believe I pay you for this mess?! Please return it the previous version ! 
You taken away something that made it feel personal and it was a pleasurable journey to go back k thru the months of each year - now it's a freaking nightmare as it's just a run on mess of cluttered photos ! Awful ! So disappointing! I have stopped  back up and I'm cancelling my  subscription. This is NOT what I pay for . As I stated -I already have an Instagram account !!
Edit to your response: oh yeah I'm sure contacting you there is going to fix everything! Not ! Google you have become a joke ! I'm returning to paying APPLE for additional storage - at least I control my iCloud storage and it's extremely user friendly and I can actually find what I'm looking for because it's organized ! Google Photos is now like a thrift store of random junk - cluttered ,  messy and for the most and  unusable!  This is what AI gets us ! Junk ! 🤬

title: Incredibly difficult to delete from Google photos and keep on phone
content: Incredibly difficult to delete from Google photos and keep on phone. Super difficult to delete pictures from Google photos and keep them on Apple. There’s no clear option for unsyncing Apple and Google, and I deleted the app before and didn’t sync photos when I got it back, then I got it back and accidentally hit accept. Since then, I haven’t been able to use my email or create new documents due to Google photos taking up too much space, when I already have an iCloud+ subscription for $1. Google also first advertised this app as unlimited storage, but I literally can’t use my email because every time I delete a Google photo it also deletes from my phone. What is the point of an external app if it doesn’t act externally? Every option they make is just buying more storage, everyone I’ve talked to with the same problem has either bought it or made a new email. Least favorite app interaction ever by far.

title: Easy to share photos but beware of the default settings
content: Easy to share photos but beware of the default settings. I signed up for Google photos to easily share photos of my young kids with extended family and it’s been working great; However I was unaware that my iPhone photos have ALL been syncing and backed up on Google cloud (which I don’t need because I already pay for Apple iCloud). Now that I’ve realized it, it’s impossible for me to undo without deleting my photos, so now I’m forced to pay for both iCloud and Google One storage for the same freaking photos. I’m disappointed (but not surprised) with the way Google forced me to pay for extra storage by making it extremely hard to undo this setting. I spent 3 hours trying to delete from Google cloud but not my device or iCloud only to fail and give up and am now resigned to paying for both iCloud and Google storage for the rest of my life because of using this app.

title: Lifesaver
content: Lifesaver. I downloaded google photos in the first place so I know that if I ever lose my iPhone, I could always recover the photos online. Today, I was careless and forgot my iPhone passcode. This required me to restart and ultimately resulted in me losing thousands of photos. Thankfully, when I re-downloaded the google photos app, I was relieved to see that all my photos and videos were safe. Although none of the photos or videos in the hidden folder were saved so I lost those for good.
